**JOIN US ON OUR MISSION TO BECOME THE #1 RETAIL TRADING PLATFORM IN THE WORLD**

Welcome to the dynamic world of NinjaTrader! As an industry-leading trading platform and futures broker, we're empowering traders to take control of their financial destiny. How do we do it? We provide cutting-edge products and services that enhance the trading journey. Whether a seasoned pro or just starting out, NinjaTrader equips traders with award-winning software and brokerage services to navigate the world's leading financial markets with confidence.

Our growth story is nothing short of exhilarating. Since 2003, NinjaTrader has been dedicated to understanding and supporting traders on their journey toward trading triumph. Through those efforts, our user base has grown to over 2 million users and we have become the number one rated futures brokerage worldwide.

But we're not stopping there. We're constantly evolving, pushing boundaries, and modernizing the futures industry. Our commitment to innovation means users will always have access to dynamic tools, real-time support, and a community of like-minded traders.

So, why work at NinjaTrader? Here, you're not just part of a team; you're part of a movement. We empower employees to reach new heights in their careers by providing a dynamic culture focused on social connection, professional development, and employee recognition initiatives. Sounds too good to be true? Take it from our employees.

Join us as we redefine what's possible in trading, advocate for our customers, and continue our journey toward becoming the world's top retail-focused trading platform in the world.

**What you'll do:**

NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.

Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.

Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.

**In this role you will:**

The marketing identity system

* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it
* Establish the governance that keeps the system intact — standards, documentation, review, and the authority to say no
* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing

Creative output and storytelling

* Concept and direct integrated campaigns from brief to launch — video, social, paid, OOH, sponsorship, events
* Develop the narrative, not just the look. You will shape the story a piece of video tells, then art-direct the production that delivers it
* Own marketing web and landing page design, including the pages that carry acquisition and conversion volume
* Direct lifecycle and product marketing creative so the experience stays coherent from first impression to funded account
* Stay personally in the work on hero projects — concepting, designing, writing direction, cutting with the editor

Team and partners

* Hire, manage and develop a small in-house design team; set the critique culture and the standard
* Brief, direct and evaluate agencies, production partners and freelancers; own creative quality of outsourced work
* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production

Cross-functional leadership

* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes
* Operate fluently inside a regulated marketing environment, partnering with compliance early rather than treating review as a downstream tax

**What you'll need:**

* 8+ years of brand and creative experience, with 2+ years leading a team as an ACD, CD or design lead
* A portfolio built on systems, not one-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data

**Bonus Points for:**

* Fintech, brokerage, trading, crypto or exchange experience, or genuine curiosity about markets and retail traders
* Experience operationalizing an inherited identity system rather than only building from scratch
* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming
* Practicing a craft outside the day job — photography, film, writing or illustration
* Agency background plus in-house leadership experience

**Compensation:**

The salary range for this role will be $166,000.00 - $216,000.00 USD. In addition, this position will also receive an annual target bonus of 15%. Bonus pay at NinjaTrader is based on individual performance (50%) as well as company/team performance (50%).

Salary and bonus earnings are only two components of the total compensation package offered by NinjaTrader. NinjaTrader offers a 401K plan through ADP under which the company will match up to 3.5% of employee contributions. Annual paid time off allowance accrues at a rate of 23 days per year plus seven paid holidays.

**Location:**

This role is based in Chicago, IL. \*There may be remote flexibility for exceptional candidates in the following states: California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

**Hybrid:**

For Chicago-based employees, we follow a hybrid work schedule: In-office Tuesday through Thursday, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays. In addition to these weekly remote days, we offer:

* 20 additional flex remote days annually
* 5 Company Wide Office-Optional weeks tied to major holidays

**Our Core Benefits Include:**

* Generous PTO
* 7 Paid Holidays Annually + 5 Conditional Holidays Annually
* 1 Service Day Annually
* 401k with 3.5% Company Match
* Paid Parental Bonding Leave
* Health, Vision, Dental Coverage

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Thesis**
Thesis is an independent agency working at the intersection of creativity, strategy, and technology. We partner with ambitious brands to solve complex business and marketing challenges and create ideas, experiences, and systems built to scale. We’re evolving how we work to bring thinking and making closer together, build more accountable teams, and use technology and AI to expand what’s creatively possible.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Creative Director at Thesis, you’ll establish the creative vision for the clients, teams, and opportunities you lead. You’ll turn business and audience challenges into ideas worth pursuing, build belief around those ideas, and lead multidisciplinary teams to make them real. You’re a thinker and a maker with strong taste, strategic instincts, and the ability to move between ideas and execution. You know when to get into the work and when to create space for others to lead. You’ll be accountable for the idea, the people, the client relationship, and the creative outcome, while managing, mentoring, and developing the next generation of creative leaders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Creative Vision & Ideas**

* Establish the creative vision for assigned clients, accounts, and opportunities.
* Turn business, audience, and cultural insights into strong ideas and creative opportunities.
* Lead concept development and ensure ideas maintain their integrity as they scale across channels, experiences, and content.

**Strategic Thinking**

* Partner with Strategy and clients to define the problem and opportunity before defining the deliverable.
* Connect creative decisions to audience needs, brand ambition, culture, and business objectives.
* Look beyond the immediate ask to identify opportunities for greater client and creative impact.

**Creative & People Leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, writing, motion, experience, content, and emerging disciplines.
* Set a high creative standard while staying close enough to the work to meaningfully shape and elevate it.
* Manage, mentor, and develop creative talent and emerging leaders through clear expectations, feedback, and meaningful opportunities for growth.
* Build teams that can increasingly operate with ownership and autonomy.

**Client Leadership & Storytelling**

* Serve as a trusted creative partner to senior clients.
* Build belief in ideas through clear, compelling storytelling and presentations.
* Navigate feedback and business constraints while protecting the creative ambition.
* Build relationships that expand Thesis’s creative influence and uncover new opportunities.

**AI, Technology & Making**

* Use AI and emerging technology to expand exploration, prototype ideas, accelerate learning, and increase the leverage of teams.
* Partner with Technology and Production to explore new ways of making and bringing ideas to life.
* Use technology to scale strong ideas without replacing human judgment, originality, and taste.

**Process & Delivery**

* Own the creative outcome from opportunity through execution.
* Build the smallest, strongest team capable of solving the problem.
* Partner across Strategy, Technology, Client Leadership, Production, and Operations to reduce handoffs and create clear ownership.
* Balance creative ambition with scope, timing, resources, and business realities.

**Growth & New Business**

* Identify opportunities to grow existing client relationships through creativity, strategy, and technology.
* Play a leadership role in new business, from opportunity framing and concept development through pitching.
* Bring proactive ideas and provocations to clients before they’re requested.

**Who You Are**

* A multidisciplinary creative leader with experience leading significant creative work, teams, and client relationships.
* An ideas person, thinker, and maker who can move between strategy, creative direction, and execution.
* A creative with exceptional taste and judgment across disciplines.
* A leader who knows how to manage, mentor, and grow creative talent.
* A compelling storyteller who can build belief with clients, teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, direct client relationships, and the pace of agency work.
* Curious and experimental with AI, technology, and new ways of making.
* Collaborative, accountable, low ego, and capable of making the people around you better.

**Relationships**

* Reports to: Chief Creative Officer
* Direct Reports & Teams: Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, writing, motion, experience, content, and emerging disciplines; manage, mentor, and develop creative talent and emerging leaders.
* Internal Cross-Functional Partners: Partner across Strategy, Technology, Client Leadership, Production, and Operations.
* External Partners: Serve as a trusted creative partner to senior clients.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**
**Requirements**
The following capabilities are required in order to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations that do not create an undue burden on the agency are available to address the following requirements:
  
  

* Using standard office equipment, computers, and related technology.
* Certain activities are performed in an environmentally controlled office setting subject to extended periods of sitting, keyboarding, and manipulating a computer mouse.
* Bending, reaching, lifting, pushing, and pulling up to 25 pounds.
* Thesis operates on a hybrid work model, with in-office collaboration Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Mondays and Fridays.
* As a proud B-Corp, Thesis prioritizes candidates based in the Portland Metro area to allow for a hybrid working set-up in our beautiful office in NW Portland.
* Minimal travel is anticipated for this role.

**Inclusion and Encouragement**
We know that experience can show up in many ways, and we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications. If you're passionate about strategy, eager to grow, and excited to contribute your perspective, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
At Thesis, we believe the best ideas come from bringing together diverse voices, experiences, and ways of thinking. Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are not checkboxes—they are essential to how we work, collaborate, and create.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees can thrive and where every individual is treated with respect and dignity.
  
  
Thesis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process for applicants with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please contact Human Resources at HR@Thesis.Agency.
  
  
As part of our commitment to equitable hiring practices, we do not request or consider applicants' salary history when making hiring decisions.

title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
  
  
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
  
  
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
  
  
Base Compensation Range
  
  
$160,000—$200,000 USD
  
  
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
  
  
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
  
  
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
  
  
We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note

title: Regional Patient Care Manager
description:
**Company Description**

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

**Why join us?**

Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now *and* build for long-term success.

**Job Description**

**How will you make an impact?**  
**Job Purpose**

As Patient Care Regional Manager, you will be the people manager and operational lead for Patient Care teams in your assigned European markets. You will own team performance, quality reviews, and day-to-day operations — while working closely with Country Managers and the Global Patient Care Head to align on priorities and ensure service consistency across markets.

You will be the missing link between global standards and local execution: someone who can read data, give direct feedback, run a tight operational cadence, and genuinely develop the people on your team.

**Key Responsibilities**

**People Management**

* Own performance reviews, 1:1s, and development conversations for direct reports across your markets
* Manage absence, availability, and team sizing for your region
* Lead hiring decisions and internal mobility within the Patient Care team
* Build a culture of direct feedback and consistent follow-through

**Operational Performance**

* Track and own regional KPIs: response SLA, first-contact resolution, CSAT, and quality scores
* Run quality review and moderation programs — calibration sessions, rubric definition, feedback loops
* Identify performance trends using dashboards and reports; translate them into concrete actions
* Own escalation protocols for complex patient cases

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Country Managers to align on priorities, workload, and service commitments
* Work with the Product/PATS team on tooling rollouts, workflow automation, and process improvements
* Contribute to the monthly Patient Voice reporting — classified ticket analysis, actionable issue surfacing
* Act as regional interface for global policy rollouts and operational changes

**Qualifications**

**What will help you thrive?**

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in customer support, patient experience, or service operations — with at least 2 years managing people
* Experience managing teams across multiple countries in Europe (not just one market)
* Strong people instincts: direct, empathetic, consistent — someone teams trust and grow under
* Data-driven: comfortable with dashboards, pulling operational reports, and making decisions from numbers
* Experience running quality review or moderation programs (calibration, rubric design, scoring)
* Fluency in English mandatory
* Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, Notion, or similar)

Esta persona gestionará y liderará cuentas con clientes nacionales e internacionales.

Epsilon Technologies es una compañía de 32 años de trayectoria en el sector del marketing, especializada en medir la cuota de atención digital del consumidor con el objetivo de ayudar a las compañías a acelerar su construcción de Brand equity.

Actualmente apoyamos a compañías líderes a nivel nacional e internacional: ej Carrefour, Leroy Merlin, La Caixa, BBVA, Gallina Blanca, Repsol, Acciona, Mercadona , etc..

Analizamos y transformamos la huella digital de los consumidores en insights accionables para incrementar el valor de marca.

Aportamos agilidad, fiabilidad y rapidez en la toma de decisiones del marketing digital, para anticiparse de manera eficaz y eficiente a las demandas de los mercados. Nuestro objetivo es consolidarnos como la herramienta global de referencia para medir la cuota de atención digital de las marcas y ser el faro digital de los directores de marketing.

Se trata de una innovación sin precedentes en la industria de la medición digital en España en la que participarás de manera directa.

title: Senior Technology Advisor – Remote
description:

PMY is a full-service provider of technology, data, and creative solutions for the live environment.

With a growing global footprint across APAC, the USA, and EMEA, we are committed to delivering tailored, impactful solutions across sectors such as Sports & Entertainment, Stadiums & Arenas, Education, Public Sector & Infrastructure, and Retail.

Across our group, we work to embody the PMY ethos – striving to be professional, dynamic, collaborative, and creative partners.

Each of our companies brings deep technical knowledge and diverse global experience, enabling us to provide a truly integrated, turn-key solution spanning consulting and design, implementation and operations, software, and data, as well as brand, creative, content, and fan experiences.

At PMY Group, we are proud to be working with more than 1,000 valued clients in 15 countries. We have built a team of more than 500 talented professionals with more than 40 years of combined industry experience.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

PMY Group and its Saudi partner, Tahreez Sport & Entertainment, are seeking a Senior Technology Advisor to join their joint venture, for a 12-month assignment. The role requires either temporary relocation to Riyadh or the ability to travel there frequently.

This is a senior, client-facing role working on some of the region’s most exciting sports, entertainment, stadium and major venue projects. You’ll work closely with senior clients to shape technology strategies, define requirements and develop practical solutions that support their business and operational goals.

You’ll be involved from the early stages of projects, helping clients make informed technology decisions and turning ideas into clear strategies and roadmaps.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and support technology advisory projects across Saudi Arabia.
* Work directly with senior client stakeholders to understand their goals and challenges.
* Develop technology strategies, roadmaps, requirements and recommendations.
* Lead workshops and stakeholder sessions and create high quality presentations and reports.
* Advise on technology solutions for stadiums, arenas, sports, entertainment and major venues.
* Work with PMY’s technology, design, digital and delivery teams to develop integrated solutions.
* Support proposals, tenders, RFPs and business development activities.
* Build strong relationships with clients, partners and technology providers.
* Stay up to date with emerging technology and industry trends.
* Travel within Saudi Arabia as required.
* Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace in accordance with company Occupational Health and Safety policies, operational standards, and relevant legislative requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Strong experience in ICT / technology advisory, consulting, professional services or technology strategy.
* Experience working directly with senior clients and stakeholders.
* Experience across sports, entertainment, stadiums, arenas, major venues or major projects is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of technology infrastructure and how different technology systems integrate within complex environments.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with proposals, tenders and RFPs.
* Good understanding of the Saudi market and its growing sports, entertainment and major projects sectors.
* Fluent English is required; Arabic is highly desirable.
* A proactive, commercial and solution-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively across clients, partners and JV stakeholders.

**WHY PMY?**

* **Shape the Future** Be part of a company bringing world-class venue and live environment technologies into Saudi Arabia across sports, entertainment, and major destinations.
* **Create Real Impact** Contribute to delivering intelligent technologies that enhance safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across the Kingdom.
* **Work Alongside Experts** Collaborate with industry professionals and global specialists across venue technologies, integrated systems, operations, and live event environments.
* **Grow With Purpose** Build your career in a dynamic sector that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and hands-on experience on ambitious projects.
* **Be Part of Something Bigger** As a strategic joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, TSE combines global innovation with strong Saudi operational capability to deliver intelligent solutions with real impact.

title: Lead VFX Artist
description:
**Company Description**

**Join The Game!**

Leader in the development and publishing of games, Gameloft® has established itself as a pioneer in the industry, creating innovative gaming experiences for over 20 years. Gameloft creates games for all digital platforms, from mobile to cross-platform titles for PC and consoles. Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Main challenge**

We are looking for a Lead VFX Artist to lead the VFX discipline across our games, combining strong artistic expertise with team coordination, visual direction, and pipeline development. You will work closely with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio to ensure a consistent visual and technical quality across all VFX, while supporting project and studio goals.

You will oversee the VFX process from initial concepts and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery. Working with our proprietary engine and in-house tools, you will also contribute to the evolution of our VFX workflows, standards, and technology.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **VFX Team Leadership:** Oversee and coordinate the VFX team, establish priorities, and ensure deadlines and quality targets are met. Identify and remove systemic blockers early and proactively adjust resources and scope.
* **Visual Direction & Quality:** Work with the Art Director to ensure visual and technical unity across all VFX. Review completed work against artistic, technical, and gameplay requirements and advance VFX quality through regular reviews.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other teams. Provide constructive feedback to internal and external partners.
* **VFX Pipeline:** Oversee the entire VFX pipeline, from initial concept and prototyping through implementation, iteration, optimisation, and final delivery.
* **Standards & Workflows:** Establish and maintain VFX standards, workflows, tools, and best practices. Ensure effects meet performance and platform requirements.
* **Team Development:** Participate in recruitment, mentor VFX artists, and foster team growth and development.

**What success will look like**

After 3 months, you will have built a strong understanding of the studio's projects, VFX workflows, team structure, and production requirements. You will have established effective working relationships with the Art Director and key stakeholders across the studio.

After 6 months, you will be independently driving VFX priorities, supporting the team in delivering against project goals, and contributing to the evolution of VFX standards, workflows, and quality across the studio.

**Who you would be working with**

You will report to the Studio Art Director and work closely with VFX artists, Art Leads, Producers, Gameplay, Tech Art, Engineering, and other art and development teams. You will also collaborate with internal and external partners throughout the production process.

**Your recruitment journey**

* HR Screen Call
* Test
* Second Interview
* Final Interview

**Where this role can take you**

This role can offer opportunities to deepen your expertise in VFX leadership, expand your responsibilities across the wider art discipline, and contribute to the development of VFX standards, workflows, and technology. You will also have access to development opportunities, mentorship, coaching, or internal mobility depending on business and individual opportunities.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Demonstrated advanced expertise in real-time VFX for games, supported by a strong portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of visual effects techniques for creating real-time VFX in a 3D game engine.
* Strong knowledge of industry-standard game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, or CryEngine.
* Solid understanding of game development and how VFX contribute to gameplay, visual feedback, and the overall player experience.
* Experience creating particle systems and VFX in 3D packages such as Maya, Houdini, or 3ds Max.
* Experience with VFX techniques and plugins for 3D software packages such as RayFire, Krakatoa, FumeFX, AfterBurn, or Maya Fluids.
* Ability to establish priorities, manage workflows, and coordinate a VFX team while maintaining quality and delivery standards.
* Ability to take initiative, provide creative input, and positively accept and apply feedback.
* Willingness to work with in-house tools and contribute to the development and improvement of proprietary game technology.
* Expertise in GLSL or HLSL would be beneficial.
* Previous experience in mobile game development would be a plus.
* Some experience with animation would also be a plus.
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken, for collaboration in an international environment.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* You are a creative and experienced VFX professional who can combine artistic vision with an understanding of production and technical requirements.
* You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different disciplines and stakeholders.
* You are comfortable giving and receiving constructive feedback and using it to improve both your own work and the team's output.
* You can organise priorities, identify blockers, and proactively find solutions in a production environment.
* You are interested in developing people, processes, and workflows alongside the quality of the VFX itself.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Permanent contract and full-time position with excellent social benefits.
* 25 vacation days per year.
* Private medical health insurance.
* Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
* Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.
* Free language courses.
* Your birthday off!
* 1 month of remote work.
* Merit-based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.
* Career development opportunities.
* Excellent working conditions, with our office located in the centre of Barcelona.
* ...and Thursday after-work beers!

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.

If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Senior Analyst / SME - EDD
description:
**About us:**

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

* CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
* FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
* Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
* LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

**About this role in the team:**

Following enhancements to our Customer Risk Assessment (CRA) methodology and the implementation of expanded Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) standards, BVNK is expanding its Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR) team.

We are seeking a Senior EDD Analyst / Subject Matter Expert (SME) reporting directly to the Head of Customer Portfolio Risk (CPR). This high-impact role will lead complex remediation activities, conduct advanced EDD reviews, perform direct customer AML control walkthroughs, and manage specialized regulatory and vertical assessments across onboarding and ongoing monitoring.

As a senior individual contributor and SME, you will handle high-risk, multi-layered corporate structures, complex product flows (e.g., Fiat Nested, Embedded Partner Managed), and specialized high-risk verticals (e.g., Gambling, CFDs/High-Risk Trading, Virtual Assets).

**Key Areas of Responsibilities:**

##### **1. Remediation & Advanced EDD Execution**

* Lead end-to-end complex EDD remediation for high-risk corporate clients under updated risk models.
* Conduct deep-dive ownership analysis on multi-layer structures (e.g., 3+ layers of legal entities, trusts, foundations, offshore/secrecy jurisdictions), identifying Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) to 10% ownership thresholds.
* Verify Source of Funds (SoF) and Source of Wealth (SoW) for entities and UBOs using commercial databases, tax returns, audited financials, and open-source intelligence (OSINT).
* Execute jurisdiction-specific EDD requirements across global operations (EU, UK, US, and APAC per local regulatory annexes).

##### **2. Regulatory & High-Risk Vertical Assessments**

* Conduct full Regulatory Assessments for regulated clients (B2B/B2C) and nested/embedded models, including license verification against official registries, equivalence reviews, and scope/permission validation.
* Perform Geographic & Reverse Solicitation Analyses, including "Initiative Tests" to identify active targeting of non-licensed jurisdictions using digital, marketing, payment rail, and operational indicators.
* Conduct sector-specific High-Risk Vertical Assessments (e,g. Gambling, CFDs & Leveraged Products, Virtual Assets &CASPs) in line with BVNK guidance.
* Research regulatory standards and high-risk verticals to support a risk-based approach and present strategic recommendations to Second Line Compliance.

##### **3. AML Control Walkthroughs & Policy Reviews**

* Lead live AML Control Walkthroughs (video and occasionally in person) with client compliance and operational teams to test and validate their live CDD, payment screening, transaction monitoring, and SAR escalation environments.
* Perform desktop reviews of third-party AML/CFT, Sanctions, and Transaction Monitoring, policies and procedures and external audit reports to identify material gaps and agree remediation action plans.

##### **4. Ongoing Portfolio Oversight & Quality Assurance**

* Manage complex scheduled Annual Periodic Reviews (APRs), Event-Driven Reviews (EDRs), and Embedded Partner Customer (EPC) reviews for higher-risk accounts.
* Act as a Checker / Escalation SME, reviewing and approving complex CDD/EDD files, risk rating shifts, account change requests, and nested flow authorisations.
* Conduct advanced transaction pattern analysis comparing 12-month transaction volumes against expected activity profiles and known risk typologies.
* Serve as a key liaison to the Second Line Compliance, MLROs, and Senior Management for high-risk client approvals and policy escalations.

**What we need from you:**

Requirements:

* 5+ years of direct experience in B2B corporate compliance, EDD, and risk assessment within high risk industries
* Recognized Subject Matter Expertise (SME) in evaluating complex corporate entities (holding companies, trusts, foundations, offshore structures).
* Deep understanding of regulatory assessment frameworks, cross-border licensing rules, and financial crime requirements (FATF, FCA, MGA, FinCEN, MiCA).
* Experience using enterprise compliance case management systems for tracking end-to-end review lifecycles.
* Exceptional written risk assessment capabilities—ability to synthesize complex financial, corporate, and transactional data into clear executive summaries.
* High autonomy, strong self-organization, and ability to manage complex case pipelines in a high-growth environment.

Nice to Have:

* Exposure to Fintech, Gaming, Crypto/VASP, and/or CFD/Fx industries
* Hands-on experience executing AML Control Walkthroughs and evaluating third-party compliance environments.
* Practical exposure to blockchain analytics tools (Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic) and Travel Rule protocol requirements.
* Strong proficiency in data querying and analytics (Snowflake SQL or similar data environment experience highly regarded).
* Proven ability to engage professionally with C-level executives, MLROs, and Compliance Directors during client walkthroughs and remediation discussions.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Fair and **competitive salary** at every stage of your growth
* **Flexible working** hours, with hybrid working at its heart
* A **culture** built on passionate, growth-minded people
* A **flexible approach to holiday**
* Opportunities to travel to our **offices around the world**
* An **open and creative environment** where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

*At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we'd encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.*

Gameloft operates its own established franchises such as Asphalt®, Dragon Mania Legends, Modern Combat and Dungeon Hunter and also partners with major rights holders including LEGO®, Universal, Illumination Entertainment, Hasbro®, Fox Digital Entertainment, Mattel®, Lamborghini®, and Ferrari®. Gameloft distributes its games in over 100 countries and employs 3,000 people worldwide. Every month, 55 million unique users can be reached by advertisers in Gameloft games with Gameloft for brands, a leading B2B offering dedicated to brands and agencies. Gameloft is a Vivendi company.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON**

**Your main challenge**

Gameloft Barcelona is looking for a **Lead Animator** to lead the animation team working on a new action-based, multi-platform IP featuring world-famous characters from a major licensor.

Your challenge will be to establish and maintain a high animation quality bar while leading and developing the team behind it. You will combine people leadership with strong animation expertise, working closely with Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners to ensure every animation supports the personality of our characters, gameplay readability and the overall player experience.

**What it means on a daily basis**

* **Lead and develop the animation team**, providing regular feedback, mentoring and guidance while supporting the individual growth of animators across different seniority levels.
* **Own the animation quality bar**, ensuring character animation delivers the expected level of movement, weight, acting, storytelling and personality while remaining consistent with the project's artistic direction and licensor expectations.
* **Plan and oversee animation production**, managing priorities, workload and delivery while keeping stakeholders informed and stepping into hands-on animation work when the team needs additional support.
* **Collaborate closely with Game Design, Programming, Art and Technical Animation** to ensure animations work effectively within gameplay, including topics related to rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
* **Coordinate animation work with external partners**, providing clear briefs, reviews and actionable feedback to ensure outsourced animation integrates consistently with the work produced internally.

**What success will look like**

**Within your first 3 months**, you will have developed a strong understanding of the project's animation direction, characters, production pipeline and team, establishing effective ways of working with the animators and key partner disciplines.

**Within 6 months**, you will be confidently leading animation production and team development, maintaining a consistent quality bar, identifying production or quality risks early and ensuring the team receives the direction and feedback needed to deliver.

**Within 9 months**, you will be a key reference for animation across the project, helping the team operate with increasing autonomy while continuously raising animation quality and strengthening collaboration between Animation, Art, Design, Programming and external partners.

**Who you would be working with**

You will report to the **Studio Art Development Director** and lead a team of **3D Animators and Technical 3D Animators**.

You will work closely with the Studio Art Director, 3D Art Lead, Game Design, Programming and other production disciplines, while also collaborating with external animation partners and the project's licensor.

**Your recruitment journey**

Our recruitment process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet the people you would work with and explore both your animation expertise and leadership experience.

* Recruiter interview
* Hiring team interview
* Animation assessment/test, where applicable
* Final interview

**Where this role can take you**

This role gives you the opportunity to take ownership of animation at project level, developing both your craft and leadership expertise while contributing to a major multi-platform IP.

You will have the opportunity to grow as an animation leader, influence animation standards and workflows, develop other artists and collaborate closely with senior creative and technical stakeholders across the project.

 **Qualifications**

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Strong expertise in **3D character animation for games**, with the ability to create and evaluate both realistic and stylized/cartoon animation.
* Excellent understanding of **movement, weight, acting, timing and storytelling**, with the ability to preserve the identity and personality of a character through animation.
* Ability to **establish, communicate and maintain animation quality standards**, translating animation principles into clear visual, written and verbal feedback.
* Strong understanding of **game animation production and real-time workflows**, including effective collaboration with Technical Animators on rigging, skinning and game-engine animation states.
* Ability to plan and prioritize animation work, manage production constraints and communicate clearly with stakeholders regarding scope, quality and delivery.
* Professional experience with industry-standard **3D animation tools and workflows**, particularly character animation pipelines such as Maya and/or 3ds Max.
* Fluent English and the ability to communicate effectively within an international and multidisciplinary development environment.
* A portfolio or showreel demonstrating strong character animation work and relevant game animation experience.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* A supportive people leader who can mentor and develop animators across different levels of seniority.
* Comfortable giving clear, constructive and actionable feedback while maintaining a high creative quality bar.
* Collaborative and able to act as a central point of communication between Animation, Art, Game Design, Programming and external partners.
* Organized and able to manage changing priorities in a dynamic production environment.
* Hands-on when needed, with a **lead-by-example** approach and the ability to balance team leadership with direct creative contribution.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!

* 25 vacation days per year.

* Flexible work-from-home hybrid model.

**We can’t wait to find our next great talent!**

Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!

Freelance and part-time. We'd like to start as soon as possible, and the work runs until the end of 2026.

description:
**NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but** **please only apply if you are physically based within LOCATION.**

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

### **About the role**

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

**Your Mission**

* Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.
* Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.
* Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.
* Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.
* Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.
* Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

* **8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage.** We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.
* **Strong data foundations.** You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.
* **Influence beyond your title.** You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.
* **You build the function, not just run it.** You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

**Nice to have**

* Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

**This role probably isn't for you if...**

* You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.
* You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.
* You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.
* You need a formal title to have influence.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.
* **100% Remote:** Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).
* **Equity:** Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.
* **Values-Driven Leadership:** Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.
* **Professional Growth:** Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.
* **Annual Paid Leave:** The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.
* **Geographic Specific Benefits:** As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.
* **Dynamic Team Culture:** As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: Head of Platform Engineering, Barcelona
description:
Head of Platform Engineering
  
About Seqera
  
  
Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.
  
  
We re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we re strengthening our internal foundations - and that s where you come in.
  
  
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a leader for our Platform Infrastructure team. This role owns infrastructure at Seqera in both directions: the internal platform our engineers build on, and the infrastructure we ship to customers. A large share of our customers experience Seqera through the infrastructure your team produces, which means much of this work is a product surface held to a products quality bar.
  
  
You will lead a team of DevOps and security engineers, and you will be a key member in our architecture review process, where infrastructure, security, and operability are weighed at design time alongside every other significant technical decision. This is a leadership role for someone who wants to define how a growing engineering organization builds, ships, and operates.
  
  
You will report to the CTO.
  
  
What Youll Do
  
  
Own the reliability, security, and cost-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, and the ongoing health of the platform - what gets maintained, upgraded, and retired, not only what gets built.
  
  
Lead the technical launch of our dedicated single-tenant hosting offering: tenancy and isolation model, provisioning, upgrade and patching strategy across many customer instances, operational tooling, and the per-tenant cost model it will be priced against.
  
  
Own our Helm charts and Terraform provider as products - versioned, documented, and tested against supported deployment topologies, with the compatibility obligations that customer-deployed infrastructure carries.
  
  
Own CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and the supported path from empty repo to production, so that teams get pipelines, deployment standards, and observability defaults without assembling them each time.
  
  
**Make cloud cost an engineering discipline:** attribution by team and by tenant, anomaly alerting, an efficiency backlog with quantified savings, and cost as an input at design time rather than a surprise after the fact.
  
  
Lead our security posture in practice - security architecture applied during design review, and the security story we present to enterprise and life-sciences customers.
  
  
**Own our formal incident response:** severity definitions, an incident commander rotation, runbooks for our top failure modes, and blameless postmortems that change something.
  
  
Define what production-ready means at Seqera - tests, observability, documentation, runbooks - and hold the bar consistently across teams.
  
  
Grow and develop the Platform Infrastructure team, including active hiring at the senior engineer level and active mentorship and career planning for the whole team.
  
  
Partner with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to bring infrastructure expertise into decisions early.
  
  
About you
  
  
You have led infrastructure, platform, or SRE teams with direct accountability for production reliability, and you are still close enough to the work to review it, set the standard, and make architectural calls yourself.
  
  
You have deep Kubernetes, Helm, and Terraform experience in enterprise settings, and strong opinions about infrastructure-as-code earned from operating it.
  
  
You have shipped infrastructure that customers deploy and run themselves. You know that charts and modules used by people you will never meet is a different discipline from internal IaC - versioning, backward compatibility, upgrade paths, and support all become your problem.
  
  
You have real security depth. You can lead a security architecture conversation rather than coordinate one.
  
  
You treat cloud cost as an engineering responsibility, and you can build cost models that stand up to commercial scrutiny.
  
  
You have built incident response rather than just carried the pager, and you have handled complex incidents including those involving customer infrastructure.
  
  
You are comfortable as a technical peer with senior engineers who will challenge you, and equally comfortable presenting to leadership and customers.
  
  
You write things down. We are moving deliberately from knowledge held by individuals to standards that are explicit, teachable, and enforceable.
  
  
You are comfortable with ambiguity, and you would rather define a platform than operate one that already exists.
  
  
**Nice to have:**  
Experience with single-tenant, dedicated, or customer-isolated deployment models - fleet provisioning, upgrade orchestration across many instances, isolation guarantees.
  
  
Developer productivity or internal developer platform experience.
  
  
Scientific, research, or high-performance computing environments large-scale batch and data-intensive workloads.
  
  
Experience with multiple cloud providers.
  
  
Release engineering experience.
  
  
Open-source community exposure - much of what we build is used in the open.
  
  
Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to enterprise life-sciences customers.
  
  
Great benefits
  
  
**Time off:** 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
  
  
Equity
  
  
Private health insurance
  
  
Private life insurance
  
  
Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
  
  
Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
  
  
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)
  
  
Location
  
  
Barcelona (Spain)
  
  
Employment Type
  
  
Full time
  
  
Department
  
  
Engineering
  
  
Nextflow, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Market Analyst
description:
**About Modo Energy**
---------------------

The energy transition is the biggest infrastructure buildout in human history. Modo Energy is the data platform at the centre of it.

We build the benchmarking, forecasting, and valuation tools that the world's most serious energy investors, developers, and operators depend on to make decisions. If a battery gets financed, built, or traded anywhere in the world, there's a good chance Modo data was in the room.

Founded in 2019, we're 90+ people across London, New York, Sydney, and Madrid; $30M Series B, AI-native, and moving fast.

This is a rare chance to join a category-defining company at the moment it's scaling globally.

**The Role**

We're hiring an Iberia Market Analyst to build Modo Energy's products for Spain and Portugal. Iberia is one of Europe's fastest-moving storage markets, and our customers rely on us to understand how batteries earn revenue there.

This is a builder's role. You'll design the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, build and ship benchmarks, and work with our European forecast team to shape the forecast product for both markets. You'll also help teach Ko, our AI analyst, to become the best source of answers on Iberia.

We're looking for a generalist. You should be as comfortable automating a data pipeline as explaining a market to a customer, and you should enjoy turning messy data into products people use.

Our coverage is battery energy storage, solar, wind and data centres, and we expect it to grow.

You'll be part of the Iberia team, reporting to the Iberia Regional Head and working closely with engineering and the European forecasting team.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and automate the data workflows behind our Iberian coverage, from TSOs, NEMOs, and other sources.
* Build, maintain and ship Iberian benchmarks, working with engineering to deploy them to customers on the Modo Energy Terminal.
* Train Ko on Iberia: Improve how useful our AI model is to clients. Expose the right datasets, improve its answers, and deepen its market knowledge.
* Work with the European forecast team on the Spanish and Portuguese forecasts: fundamentals, market design, and how regulatory and market changes feed into the models.
* Maintain a grid-scale asset and capacity register for Spain and Portugal.
* Use AI to build tools and workflows that help you and the team scale.
* Contribute market insight through research and customer calls.

**What We're Looking For**

*The Essentials*

* You like building things, and you use AI to build tools and workflows.
* 2+ years of experience in power markets, energy analytics, data, or a technical analyst role.
* Strong programming skills. You can interrogate complex datasets and pick up new tools quickly.
* Familiarity with battery energy storage or wider energy transition themes.
* A generalist mindset: comfortable moving between data, product, and market questions.
* Clear written communication.
* Professional fluency in Spanish and English.
* You're comfortable building products for a region from the ground up.

*Nice To Have*

* Knowledge of Iberian electricity markets: OMIE day-ahead and intraday, REE balancing services (aFRR, mFRR, RR), and the capacity mechanism.
* Experience with data pipelines or workflow orchestration (e.g. Airflow, Dagster, dbt).
* Experience building data products or modelling tools, such as revenue models or dispatch optimisation.
* A working knowledge of Portuguese.

**Please note we can only consider candidates who already have the right to work in Spain, as we can't offer visa sponsorship at this time.**

**Equal Opportunity**

Modo Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at careers@modoenergy.com.

**What You Can Expect From Us**
-------------------------------

At Modo Energy, we believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional reward. We're a high-performance team; ambitious, collaborative, and genuinely motivated by the scale of what we're trying to build.

You'll have real ownership from day one, work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry, and be part of a company that's defining a new category in the global energy market. We're hybrid: everyone works Tuesday to Thursday in office, with Monday and Friday flexible. We offer top-of-market compensation, equity for every employee, and the space to take your career wherever you want it to go.

We're looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers. If that's you, we want to talk.

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**Lead engineering that powers how thousands of finance teams spend**
=====================================================================

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform trusted by thousands of finance teams across Europe. As our **Head of Engineering**, you'll lead a complete engineering group — several Engineering Managers, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers — reporting directly to our CTO. You'll set the technical and organisational direction for your area, build the leadership team that runs it, and be accountable for the economics, reliability, and pace of everything it ships.

You will work with 2 to 4 Engineering Managers, reporting directly to you. You will collaborate with the Head of Product and the Head of Design, and other Head of Engineering responsible for other groups.

Your will be responsible for a multi-disciplinary engineering team of 20-30 people, with different seniority and skillset, spread across Europe.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Technical & organisational strategy**

* Define the multi-quarter technical and organisational strategy for your group, aligned with Spendesk's company strategy.
* Drive architectural decisions and simplification across your domain — clear domain boundaries, “platformisation”, debt reduction.
* Make build vs. buy vs. partner calls, and own your group's AI/tooling strategy: what to standardise, what to pilot, and how you measure impact.
* Own your area's economics — cost-to-serve, infra efficiency, hiring ROI — with a clear quarterly view, and present the commercial rationale behind your investment decisions.

**Delivery & operations**

* Be accountable for delivery and outcomes across your full portfolio of squads, balancing competing priorities without losing sight of quality.
* Establish group-level KPIs, SLOs, and operating rhythms so your teams run well without you in every room.
* Champion end-to-end observability, sensible on-call, and postmortems that actually change things — reducing incident frequency and MTTR over time.
* Sequence hiring and headcount to maximise impact, and defend that plan to stakeholders with data.

**Building your leadership team**

* Hire, develop, and retain a strong, balanced leadership team of EMs, Senior EMs, and Staff Engineers.
* Coach your managers through their hardest calls: performance conversations, hiring decisions, prioritisation trade-offs.
* Lead performance calibration for your group and make the final call on promotions and compensation.
* Build succession plans for your key leadership roles, so no single departure puts your group at risk.
* Actively invest in retaining your best people, and keep a genuine pulse on team sentiment.

**Influence beyond your team**

* Represent Engineering in company-wide forums, partnering closely with Product, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams.
* Communicate your strategy and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and executives — you're as comfortable defending a roadmap to the leadership team as you are challenging an incident response plan.
* Champion diversity and inclusion in how you hire, develop, and run your organisation.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* 8+ years in software engineering with increasing scope, including 3+ years managing managers (Team Leads/EMs).
* A track record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder programmes in product-led SaaS on time, on budget, with measurable results. Fintech, payments, or compliance experience is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience operating distributed systems at scale in production, and enough technical depth to earn credibility with ICs and Team Leads, not just manage around them.
* Comfort with our stack (TypeScript, Node, React, AWS…). You don't need to write code daily, but you need to read it and question it.
* Real business acumen: you can talk unit economics, ROI, and trade-offs as fluently as you talk architecture.
* A genuine track record of growing managers into better managers, not just engineers into better engineers.

**Why this role, why now**
==========================

You'll join at a moment where the group you lead has room to simplify, room to invest in AI-augmented engineering, and a leadership team worth building further. You'll have a documented path behind you and ahead of you: Spendesk's Engineering Leadership Growth Journey maps the road from Engineering Manager through Head of Engineering to CTO, so you'll know exactly what's expected of you, and what growing further looks like once you're here.

You'll be based in one of our offices (Paris, London or Barcelona), with a flexible on-site rhythm agreed with your team.

As we are an international team, please submit your application and CV in English.

**About Spendesk**

Spendesk is the AI-powered spend management and procurement platform that transforms company spending. By simplifying procurement, payment cards, expense management, invoice processing, and accounting automation, Spendesk sets the new standard for spending at work. Its single, intelligent solution makes efficient spending easy for employees and gives finance leaders the full visibility and control they need across all company spend, even in multi-entity structures. Trusted by thousands of companies, Spendesk supports over 200,000 users across brands such as Payfit, Accor, Welcome to the Jungle, Swile, Big Mamma, Malt and Yousign. With offices in the United Kingdom, France, Spain and Germany, Spendesk also puts community at the heart of its mission.
  
  
For more information: www.spendesk.com/press  
  
**About our people & culture**

We believe that people do their best work when they’re given the freedom to thrive and grow. That’s why liberation is at the core of everything we do. We empower Spendeskers to take ownership of their work, to navigate ambiguity, and seize every opportunity. Spendeskers come from all over the world (35+ countries and counting!) but we have plenty in common: we're bold, ever-curious, committed to kindness, and tackle every challenge with a positive mindset.
  
  
**About our benefits**

Our culture is built on trust, empowerment, and growth — with benefits to match!

* Flexible on-site and remote policy
* Latest Apple equipment — the tools you need to excel
* Access to Moka.care — for emotional and mental health wellbeing
* Great office snacks — to fuel your day
* A positive team to work with daily!

We also offer location-specific benefits tailored to each market, including health insurance, wellness allowances, commuter support, meal vouchers, and gym memberships — ensuring you're well supported wherever you're based.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Spendesk, we're committed to fostering an environment where all differences are encouraged, supported and celebrated. We're building our culture for everyone, with everyone. Our goal is to attract and build a diverse, equal and inclusive team, where everyone feels welcome and we truly embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Project Manager (Video Ads)
description:

------------

We're Camping, a brand storytelling and video agency in Barcelona. We help B2B tech companies go from 'boring' to heartfelt, through brand work and video.

Have we mentioned we have a 4-day workweek?

**The role**
