We have more video ad campaigns coming in than our project team can run, and some of them could start in the next few weeks. So we're looking for one more project manager, as a freelancer.

A campaign for us is usually 6 to 12 ads, and then the cutdowns, resizes and language versions for every platform. More and more often the videos are made fully or partly with AI. You take the campaign from the kickoff call to the last file. You're the client's main contact, you send them scripts and cuts, collect their feedback and turn it into clear next steps for the team.

You'll work with our creative director, strategists, AI creatives, producers and freelance editors and motion designers. You won't be the director or the strategist. You'll be the person who knows where every ad stands and tells us early when something slips. Most of the work is in post-production, the rest is pre-production and shoots.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run several video ad campaigns at the same time, from kickoff to final delivery
* Be the client's day-to-day contact: send scripts, cuts and updates, and run the feedback rounds
* Plan pre-production and shoots with our producers, directors and production partners
* Book and brief freelance editors, motion designers, color and sound, and track every revision round
* Keep Asana, Notion and Frame.io up to date, so anyone on the team can see where a project stands
* Check every ad before it goes to the client: formats, aspect ratios, subtitles, specs for each platform
* Flag changes to timeline, budget or scope to our Head of Production before you promise anything to the client

description:

title: Affiliate Manager
description:
**About PFM**  
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

**About the department**  
Marketing owns how PFM finds, engages, and converts traders across every channel we use to grow. Affiliate and influencer partnerships are one of our biggest acquisition channels - over $60K a month in spend - and as that function matures under our Owned Media team, our priority is turning it into a well-negotiated, well-tracked channel instead of one that runs on relationships alone.

**About the role**  
The Affiliate Manager builds an affiliate channel that creates measurable, profitable growth for PFM: turning the right partner relationships into qualified traffic, conversions, and durable revenue, while protecting deal quality and spend efficiency. This role establishes the commercial discipline and tracking PFM needs to scale partnerships into priority markets with confidence. It backfills our outgoing Affiliate Manager as they step into leading Owned Media, and works alongside our Influencer Partnerships Specialist, providing light day-to-day direction on their pipeline and priorities. Without a dedicated owner here, deals on one of our largest acquisition channels get missed or under-negotiated.

 **Requirements**

**Performance objectives**

**Objective 1 - Build and activate a productive affiliate portfolio**  
**Outcome:** Within the first 6–12 months, the active portfolio is stronger in priority markets and produces a growing share of qualified traffic and attributable conversions - not simply more signed partners.

**Typical tasks:**

* Map priority regions, partner segments, and target accounts with the Head of Owned Media.
* Source and qualify affiliates on audience fit, traffic quality, commercial potential, and brand suitability.
* Move qualified prospects through outreach, negotiation, onboarding, activation, and first performance review.
* Re-engage, expand, or exit existing partners based on contribution and strategic fit.

**Objective 2 - Improve deal quality and partner economics**  
**Outcome:** New and renewed agreements have clear economics and accountable deliverables; spend and effort shift toward partnerships with stronger return.

**Typical tasks:**

* Negotiate commission structures, fees, placements, deliverables, tracking requirements, and review points.
* Model expected cost and return before committing spend or recommending exceptions.
* Document agreed terms and coordinate approvals, contracts, and handoffs.
* Review underperforming deals and recommend renewal, renegotiation, or exit.

**Objective 3 - Make affiliate-driven results measurable and actionable**  
**Outcome:** Leadership can see attributable revenue, cost, and conversion quality by partner; material data gaps are resolved and commercial decisions follow the evidence.

**Typical tasks:**

* Set tracking and attribution requirements before launch and verify links, codes, and reporting access.
* Reconcile partner-reported activity with internal traffic, sales, and commission data alongside Analytics & Data and Finance.
* Investigate material discrepancies, low-quality traffic, and conversion changes through to resolution.
* Turn performance reviews into specific actions on partner mix, terms, creative, placement, or budget.

**Objective 4 - Build a repeatable partnership operating system and content governance**  
**Outcome:** Priority markets have a visible, qualified pipeline; launches and reviews happen on time; agreed placements go live as contracted, and partner content about PFM is accurate and up to date; the channel can scale without losing commercial control or partner experience.

**Typical tasks:**

* Maintain a current deal pipeline with owner, stage, expected value, next step, and decision date.
* Establish onboarding, briefing, compliance, and performance-review standards for partners.
* Coordinate with the Influencer Partnerships Specialist on shared deal governance and measurement without duplicating ownership of influencer negotiations.
* Monitor what partners publish about PFM for accuracy, brand suitability, and compliance, and act on issues through to resolution.
* Verify that agreed placements and deliverables go live on time and as specified, and keep partner-facing offers, promo codes, creatives, and campaign details current.

**What we look for**  
**Must-Have Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar affiliate, influencer, or partnerships role, with hands-on ownership of deal sourcing and negotiation end to end.
* Fluent professional English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong AI proficiency — comfortable using AI as part of daily work, including experience building or using small automations to improve outreach, tracking, or reporting.
* Working knowledge of Docusign and Calendly, or comparable contract and scheduling tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, Zoom, and Slack for documentation, scheduling, forms, communication, and remote collaboration.
* Basic working knowledge of partnership/affiliate contract terms, with the ability to identify when Legal or Finance input is required.
* Strong organization and follow-through — able to manage a multi-deal pipeline where a missed follow-up can cost a partnership or measurable revenue.
* Clear, direct communication — able to prepare and communicate deal terms, performance updates, and negotiation outcomes accurately to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong discretion and judgment, given regular access to spend data, deal terms, and partner performance information.
* A relationship-first negotiation style — able to build trust with partners while still protecting PFM's commercial interests.
* Strong cross-functional coordination skills — comfortable working closely with Analytics & Data, Marketing, Strategic Initiatives, and leadership to bring deals and tracking work to completion.

**Nice to Have**

* Previous experience in a fully remote, global, and multicultural team.
* Experience in a fast-scaling organization where affiliate/partnership processes are still being built and improved.
* Deeper experience with AI integrations, workflow automation, and attribution/tracking tooling beyond basic usage.

**Compensation**  
$3,500 - $4,000 / monthly gross

**Location & work setup**  
Remote, CET-aligned working hours.  
Employment type: Full-time.

 **Benefits**

**Hiring stages**  
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

* Application screening – We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
* Video intro + role fit questionnaire – A short async step - no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
* Discovery HR interview – A conversation with our People team focused on company and culture match - how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
* Practical task – A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM affiliate/partnership challenge, not an abstract problem, designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
* Professional interview – A conversation with the Head of Owned Media focused on your negotiation experience, how you've owned an affiliate or partnership channel end to end, and how you handle sensitive or ambiguous deal situations.
* Functional interview – A broader professional conversation exploring how you work with commercial teams and partners, how you structure and present data to support business decisions, and how you identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* Peer & values conversation – A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.  
To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.

**Before applying take into account that:**  

* If you don’t meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires - we encourage you to apply.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
* Even if it’s not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.

  
**Not the right fit for this role?**  
If this role isn’t the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area - we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

**Launch Strategy**

* You are accountable for driving the Global Pre-Launch strategy and planning 12-18 months prior to launch and providing commercial input into development programs.

* Partnering with (R&D, Operations, Corporate Affairs, Finance, et al) and regional/local teams to develop relevant launch strategy. Additionally, working with regional colleagues to plan the market shaping activities 12-18 months prior to launch

**Business & Commercial Performance**:

* You are responsible for development and evolving the commercial strategy (positioning, messaging, claims, patient/HCP segmentation …etc.). in partnership with Regional Commercial leads to ensure local execution of strategy.

* You are responsible for the development, communication and evolution of long-range global forecasts for your portfolio (LTP)

**Pipeline**:

* As the pipeline evolves, this role will also be instrumental in partnering with R&D, BD and other enterprise functions to support Business Cases for pipeline assets to be assessed by the Leadership team

**You will need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in business or life sciences; a Masters degree would be supportive

* Minimum 10+ years in pharmaceutical or biotech industry in roles encompassing strategic pre-launch planning and launch, with global/regional/local experience and thorough understanding of the diverse requirements of Global markets

* Country and/ or above-country leadership experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with accountability and a proven track record for delivering on business goals in a major healthcare market; PnL responsibility would be supportive

* Broad marketing and commercial experience with demonstrated success across various stages of the brand lifecycle, including pre-launch planning, launch execution, and long-term business planning

* Profound understanding of drug development and commercialization in rare disease

* Solid grasp of ongoing paradigm changes and future trends in healthcare commercialization

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across matrix teams and achieve goals by delivering through others

* Proven experience and knowledge of a broad base of external partners and customers including patients, prescribers, payors, providers and in/out license partners.

* P&L management experience and ability to build a financial Business Case

* Experienced with key global regulations in the field of pharmaceutical compliance and commercialization, including pharmacovigilance

* Excellent communications skills across a diverse set of stakeholders (commercial, clinical, medical, etc.)

**We would prefer you to have:**

* An advanced degree (MBA, MSc or PhD) is preferred

* Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience at the Global, Regional and Local level.

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit and strategic mindset including innovation and critical thinking with performance-oriented drive.

* You can integrate a variety of perspectives into meaningful strategies and programs.

* You embrace curiosity, collaboration and smart risk taking as a prerequisite for joint success.

* You enthusiastically embrace the diversity of individual healthcare ecosystems as significant opportunity.

* You can relate and connect deeply with various healthcare and business markets to deliver direction and support.

* You can create and mobilize an inclusive work environment of highest integrity and quality, fostering learning, growth, teamwork, individual development and attraction of top talent.

* You possess excellent communication skills and a strong personal presence internally and externally, acting as a strong catalyst and influencer.

title: Global Head of Operations Excellence
description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Further supporting our growth and innovation momentum, we are establishing a new Global Capability Center in Barcelona to deploy new capabilities to effectively support its global commercial and functional teams. Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.

**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  
  
Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end-to-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.

Working with Operations functions, and their embedded excellence resources, including Supply Chain, Quality, External Supply, Industrial Development and Plant leadership, you will coordinate and prioritize the required support for the entire Industrial Operations organization and will ensure standardization, where appropriate, in liaison with the other leaders. Knowledge sharing and communication of best practices will also be a key component of this position across Galderma.

**About The Role**

As Global Head of Operations Excellence, reporting to the Global Head of Operations, you will drive knowledge sharing across the organization by establishing key practitioner groups focused on continuous end to end improvements and convergence on identified best practices. By creating collaboration across departments and functions throughout the Operations organization you will ensure alignment of strategy and tactics for successful excellence implementation.

You will be responsible for the design, development and implementation of our global lean supply and manufacturing program with the intent to establish linkage and flow, meet customer demand at lowest cost with perfect quality, consolidate rationalization and enhance organizational agility.

You will be the primary architect and leader of our Operations Excellence Transformation and as such will work to establish programs, practices metrics and standards utilizing lean methodologies, analyze and recommend future state value stream design and also identify opportunities to improve existing practices, procedures and processes toward true north vision. You will lead and mentor leaders and multi-functional teams to implement a standardized excellence methodology to ensure consistent and rigorous application across the business in line with best practice.

Based in Barcelona or London, the position holder will be a member of our Operations Leadership Team, and partner closely with various department to collaborate on all aspects of the company's Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing/Procurement and Supply Chain strategies.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement Galderma’s end-to-end Operations Excellence transformation strategy and deploy a program for lean development across our global supply, industrial and manufacturing footprint including coordination of our drive to 85% Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)
* Continuously structure, coordinate and update the Operations function annual strategy plan through a clear methodology based on the Hoshin process including dashboard accountability for all Operations functions.
* Conduct Extended Value Stream Baseline analysis, Supplier summit and Kaizen events with site and function leaders to improve performance in the identified areas requiring lean/kaizen support. Provide high level, lean master/sensei support to help build capability and ensure required event objectives are achieved. In addition to that, responsible for progressing lean continuous Improvement (CI) and lean culture penetration.
* Pilot Operations’ evaluation of performance, rationalization and agility through cross functional dashboard ownership and reporting.
* Utilize, drive and promote understanding of Lean and Six-Sigma tools and principals to ensure the delivery of business objectives and a culture of continuous improvement; develop and implement improvement plans, facilitate daily visual management, lean conversion and root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
* Provide expertise, professional advice and guidance to the business in business improvement, drawing from proven industry practice and methodologies
* Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the Lean strategy
* Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on Lean methodologies. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimizing cost
* Effectively coach teams to manage for daily performance using visual controls
* Mentor using Gemba walks and other lead standard work toolkits.
* Coach employees to see abnormal conditions and problem solve systematically
* Lead kaizen events to bring Operations to standard, or improve work performance toward true north
* Ensure 5S/RCCA is taught, implemented and adhered throughout the organization.
Coordinate, schedule and facilitate as applicable Lean/Six Sigma activities to enhance cross-functional problems solving; utilize Company tool champions as appropriate for more significant lean events  

**About You**

* Solid experience in highly performing manufacturing structures operating at 85%+ OEE.
* Involvement building and leading successful projects and programs with an understanding of the tactics needed for execution, including overall upskilling and upscaling of manufacturing performance.
* Ambitious, entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business
* Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage executives
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple work streams at once
* Exceptional critical thinking and ability to professionally advance others’ understanding of lean metrics and goals
* Result and customer focused with a successful record of accomplishments through skilled use of influence, persuasion, negotiation and resolution
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate projects status needs across different levels of the organization and different operating environments
* Determined focused leader; ability to quickly establish credibility throughout the organization by effectively balancing strategic as well as on-going operations & execution levels
* Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Relationship builder and can hold people accountable while making them feel energized about the road ahead
* Anticipate the needs of teammates, give and get all the facts making it easy for all to make decisions
Mastery is expected but not limited to JIT, takt, flow, pull, standard work sheet, Jidoka, DMAIC, A3, policy deployment, Toyota production system, TPM, continuous flow, continuous improvement, error proofing, eliminating waste, 5 why’s, heijunka, Kanban, kaizen, linearity, pacemaker, pitch, replenishment system, SWIP, supermarket, standardized work, standard work combo sheet, value stream mapping, visual management.  

**Requirements**

  

* Background in manufacturing, Supply Chain and/or engineering environments within a large global organization, including site manufacturing leadership experience
* Master Black Belt in Six Sigma or equivalent qualification
* Automotive or cost oriented company experience preferred
* Background in people management, project management and digital transformation
* Qualified Trainer certification and experience would be appreciated
* Membership of an industry-related professional body would be advantageous

**About This Role**

* First marketing hire: you will be the first person in marketing at Janus Digital, and we will build the team around you. Initially you must be capable of, and willing to, carry out every aspect of marketing yourself – from strategy and positioning through content, paid media, MarTech and reporting – with a strong focus on sales enablement and AI-native ways of working.
* Strategy and execution in one seat: you own Janus Digital’s marketing strategy end to end, setting direction, priorities and budget, and then deliver it day to day, sleeves rolled up.
* This is not a delegate-only director role: you will run campaigns, manage the MarTech stack and execute paid media personally while you build and shape the team around you.

 **Requirements**

**What You’ll Do**

* Own and set Janus Digital’s marketing strategy: market prioritisation, positioning, channel mix, budget allocation and annual and quarterly plans, aligned with commercial leadership.
* Define and refine Janus Digital’s commercial narrative and our outcome-based value proposition for C-suite economic buyers (CEOs, COOs, CFOs).
* Architect and run Account-Based Marketing across our launch markets, Singapore and the UK, extending as we scale.
* Pioneer paid Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and chatbot advertising, alongside hands-on paid LinkedIn and Google SEM.
* Make sales enablement a core priority: build and maintain the sales and partner toolkit – ROI calculators, pitch decks, battlecards, case studies and objection-handling scripts – and work closely with sales to keep it sharp and in use.
* Manage LinkedIn as our priority social channel, including ghostwriting for our Global CEO and Singapore CEO.
* Deploy and independently manage a lean, AI-native MarTech stack (Attio, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Koala, Supabase, Evidence.dev, a headless website, Cookiebot), orchestrated through Slack and Claude.
* Use AI tools and agents daily to multiply your output across research, content, campaign build, personalisation, analytics and reporting, so you can operate at the pace of a full function from day one.
* Report pipeline contribution and outcome-based value attribution against the model agreed with commercial leadership.

  

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12 years of progressive B2B technology marketing experience, selling to C-suite buyers through long, trust-led cycles (not self-serve or product-led SaaS).
* Experience owning marketing strategy, ideally as a Head of Marketing or senior manager ready to step up, combined with the willingness to execute everything yourself – this role is genuinely hands-on until the team is in place.
* A true builder mentality: experience as a first or early marketing hire in a scaling company, and the ambition to build a team.
* Strong, practical AI capability: confident using generative AI tools, agents and automation (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, workflow automation) to plan, create and run marketing at scale.
* Proven sales enablement experience: creating the content, tools and processes that help sales teams win complex, high-value deals.
* Practical campaign experience across Singapore/APAC and the UK/Europe.
* Expert, hands-on experience running Google Ads, SEM and complex LinkedIn paid architectures.
* A demonstrated history of independently rolling out CRM, automation, data and reporting stacks.
* Sharp technical and commercial editing capability, with confident ghostwriting in an executive voice.
* Exposure to institutional financial services marketing (e.g. private equity, asset management) is a strong plus; familiarity with real estate or proptech also helps, though neither is essential.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Prior exposure to paid and organic Answer Engine Optimisation.
* Exposure to partner-led (B2B2B) go-to-market motions.
* A background marketing to PE, VC or institutional finance, or marketing tech/data intelligence services.

 **Benefits**

**What We Offer**

* Full ownership of marketing strategy and delivery, and the opportunity to build and lead the team, with a defined path to CMO as the business scales.
* Genuine autonomy to shape how marketing works at Janus Digital, and to build the team around you.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AI-native growth methodologies, ahead of the market.
* High-stakes global execution across Dubai, Singapore and the UK (with a progressive roadmap which encompasses much more)

**Commercial Execution & Enablement Manager – Healthcare – Barcelona**

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

**Benefits:**  
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act.

**Rights Under the Fair Chance Act:**  
Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact careers@xsolla.com.

*By submitting the following job application form, you consent to Xsolla processing your data for career-related inquiries and potential employment opportunities. We process your data in accordance with this**Xsolla Privacy Notice for Job Applicants**. Please direct any inquiries regarding your data privacy to* *careers@xsolla.com**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director, Product Management, Marketplace Supply
description:
**Who we are:**

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

**About the role**  
Rover is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Provider Product Group inside our Global Provider Organization. In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution of Rover's multi-year provider roadmap: concentrating investment on our most successful providers while engaging our broader community of caregivers to strengthen marketplace depth and develop a high quality pipeline.  
You will lead four product teams working in service to our care providers, improving their experience and how they interact with the marketplace at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact role that requires a unique blend of strategic vision and detailed-oriented, hands-on execution. You will set multi-year product direction and drive rigorous, experiment-led execution. The role carries direct accountability for supply-side revenue, provider retention, and new-customer booking growth.  
This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Supply based in Barcelona, and partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Design, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and the International Business Team.  
As a people leader, you will manage a team of product managers based primarily in Barcelona and coordinate with cross-functional teams across Europe and the US.

* *This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.*

### **What you'll own**

Execution is delivered hand-in-hand with cross-functional partners; your job is to define the vision and what good looks like, sequence the bets, hold the alignment, and make sure all investments reinforce each other through excellent execution.

* **Product Strategy and Vision.** Own the multi-year provider product vision: translating Rover's provider strategy into a sequenced product direction and owning the narrative that aligns leadership, product teams, and partners behind it.
* **Roadmap and execution.** Own the product side of the organization's OKRs and the roadmap that delivers them. Ship a steady cadence of well-crafted, experiment-validated launches, landed with quality and followed through after launch until the customer outcome is proven or the outcome is learned.
* **The voice of the provider.** You will be the advocate for what providers actually want and need to grow and run top quality businesses, grounding every roadmap decision in customer research, feedback, and marketplace data, and representing that voice credibly in every executive conversation, including when it's inconvenient.
* **AI adoption.** AI embedded in product features such as assisted tooling, intelligent messaging, personalization and education, as well as fostering AI in how the team works (AI-accelerated discovery, prototyping, execution), while building a culture of AI-native development as the default.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** Hold alignment across Core Product Teams, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal and Trust & Safety, and across regions, so that product investments reinforce each other globally rather than fragmenting by service, brand or country.
* **A team that sets the bar.** Hire, coach and grow a team of product managers who combine judgment, customer centricity, inspiring craft and speed.

### **Minimum qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in marketplace, platform, or two-sided business contexts. Experience in the supply-side of the marketplace is a plus.
* 5+ years in people management or leadership roles, including managing senior product managers or leading cross-functional groups.
* Experience driving marketplace monetization — pricing, fee, or take-rate models — including designing, testing, and scaling pricing changes with measurable P&L impact.
* Track record of building retention, engagement, and loyalty strategies for a professional user segment (providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, or merchants).  
  Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering teams to create and execute on shared roadmaps and metrics, with rigorous experimentation practice (A/B frameworks, holdouts, long-horizon measurement).
* Clear and structured written and verbal communication style, with the ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse teams to drive critical decisions.
* Highly proactive, comfortable operating with minimal guidance in uncertain and ambiguous business environments.
* Analytical rigour, with enthusiasm for modeling and measuring the impact of the initiatives you drive. Comfortable working with advanced analytical and visualization tools, such as Mode and Excel.
* Strong leadership skills and experience giving actionable feedback and coaching, and welcoming the same.
* Comfortable working across Europe (Central Time) and US (Pacific Time) timezones.
* Strong command of the English language (minimum C2 level). English is the official Rover language and is used every day with every stakeholder and communication.  
  Bachelor's degree.

### **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in online marketplaces with a meaningful supply side (gig economy, services marketplaces, accommodation, mobility, creator platforms, or similar).
* Experience with marketplace integrity problems: disintermediation and off-platform leakage, and incentive design that rewards loyal behavior.
* Experience building customer-centric tooling, business-management software, or 'operating system' products for independent entrepreneurs.
* Demonstrated success leading both 0-to-1 product bets and scaling existing product lines; comfort presenting to C-level and Board audiences.
* Master's degree.

### **Benefits of working at Rover:**

* Competitive compensation
* Permanent contract
* Long-term incentive plan, with a company performance-based cash payout
* Pension Plan
* Meal tickets through Cobee
* 25 days paid time off, plus public holidays
* Private health insurance
* Discounted gym membership
* Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
* Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
* Flexible work hours. We trust you to get your work done, and are not watching what times you're coming and going
* Snacks and fresh fruit in our kitchen to keep yourself going
* Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

### **Compensation:**

* In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €122,228 - €148,155. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Engineering Manager - Platform
description:
**About Us**

At **Nextlane**, we don’t just develop software solutions – we **create the future** of the automotive industry.

We are a company that combines **advanced technology** with a clear vision: **simplifying and digitizing** every step of the automotive customer journey, empowering manufacturers and dealerships to thrive in a constantly evolving market.

We believe in the value of every team member, offering opportunities for you to **develop** and contribute to meaningful solutions.

So… What does it mean to be a #Nextlaner?

* Be part of agrowth-oriented culture.
* Collaborate with **colleagues from all over the world.**
* Believe in the Power of ideas and the diversity of thought.
* Be committed to provide an environment where you can **learn, grow, and collaborate** on projects that make a global impact.

Our success is measured not just by results, but also by the growth and satisfaction of those who are part of our company.

At Nextlane, you’ll have the opportunity to **innovate**, **push boundaries**, and **work on solutions that are transforming** the automotive world.

**Your Responsibilities:**

As Engineering Manager for Platform, you will lead a team of 8-10 engineers across France, Portugal and Spain, responsible for the APIs, the API gateway and the integration services that connect Nextlane's products with dealers, partners, OEMs, and each DMS and CRM. Reporting to the VP Engineering - Platform, you will be accountable for team development, delivery predictability, service reliability and security, and the technical sustainability of the platform.

You will partner closely with Platform Product, Architecture, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, the OEM Interfaces and DMS/CRM teams, and the product teams that build on the platform. Product owns the vision, the roadmap, and the what and why; you own engineering capacity, delivery planning, and the when and how. You will treat the teams that depend on the platform as customers: agree contracts and service levels with them, make risks, dependencies and trade-offs visible, and say no with reasons when you need to.

This is a technically credible leadership role, not a full-time coding position. You must be able to review API and integration designs, challenge architectural decisions, guide engineers, and go into the code or production diagnostics when an incident needs it.

This role needs a change-oriented leader who can improve how the platform is built and run while keeping it available to the products, partners and dealers that depend on it.

**1) Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of 8-10 engineers across France, Portugal and Spain.
* Hold regular one-to-ones, give clear feedback, manage performance, build career plans.
* Own the team's hiring, onboarding, capability planning and succession.
* Grow technical leadership inside the team, with clear accountability.
* Build a team where people learn continuously and feel safe to raise problems early.

**2) Platform, APIs & Integrations**

* Own the reliability and evolution of the APIs and integration services Nextlane's products, partners, dealers and OEMs depend on: the API gateway, the integration layer and the connectivity to each DMS and CRM.
* Treat APIs as products: clear contracts, versioning and deprecation rules, backward compatibility, documentation consumers can trust.
* Agree interfaces and service levels with the product teams building on the platform, and make it easy to adopt: self-service onboarding, SDKs, contract tests.
* Help move integrations onto the platform's shared front door, working with the OEM Interfaces and DMS/CRM teams on common standards.
* Build security into every API: authentication and authorisation, secrets management, rate limiting, vulnerabilities fixed on time.

**3) Delivery Ownership & Predictability**

* Turn roadmap priorities into realistic plans, with estimates and dates you revise openly when things change.
* Own sprint planning, capacity, reviews and retrospectives, and protect the team from unplanned scope.
* Present the team's plan, commitments and dependencies in each planning cycle.
* Manage a platform's many cross-team dependencies, and release readiness.
* Use delivery metrics to improve predictability and report progress honestly.

**4) Product & Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with Platform Product in a clear model: product owns the *what* and *why*, engineering owns the *when* and *how*.
* Make sure work is ready before it's committed; challenge unclear requirements.
* Ensure every platform change is reviewed and merged by the team that owns it.
* Bring engineering input to discovery, feasibility and the roadmap; handle critical technical escalations with other teams and customers.

**5) Quality, SDLC & Operational Excellence**

* Run a disciplined, traceable SDLC with Jira as the source of truth: Definitions of Ready and Done, quality gates, release criteria.
* Build the right automated-testing strategy, including contract tests for the APIs others depend on.
* Define and meet service-level objectives; own on-call, incident response and post-incident reviews.
* Balance roadmap delivery, defects, operational support and technical debt.

**6) Technical Leadership & Modernisation**

* Review solution designs with our Architecture Practice and challenge choices when needed.
* Lead the modernisation of long-lived integration software while keeping the service running.
* Make technical debt visible and tie it to business impact.
* Lead the Engineering team to AI driven development where sensible, ensuring Platform is ready for AI-enabled use: APIs agents can call safely, with identities, limits and audit.

**7) Cloud, DevOps & Production Operations**

* Operate cloud workloads (AWS preferred) in a hybrid estate - cloud services plus software installed at dealer sites.
* Drive CI/CD, infrastructure automation and release management across that estate.
* Use logs, metrics, traces and alerts to keep services healthy, available and resilient.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **Experience:** 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ managing engineering teams; built or operated APIs, integration platforms or shared services used by other teams or external partners; led modernisation while keeping delivery going; handled customer-impacting incidents.
* **Technical skills:** distributed systems and API design (REST, versioning, gateways); integration patterns (mapping, messaging, events); cloud operations (AWS preferred), containers, CI/CD; API security (OAuth2, mTLS, rate limiting); observability and SLOs.
* **Languages:** fluent English (mandatory; interviews in English); French a plus.
* **Communication:** clear and direct, in writing and in person; negotiates priorities with internal customers.
* **Interpersonal skills:** strong people management and coaching; makes hard trade-offs and says no with reasons; ownership under ambiguity.
* **Nice to have:** automotive, DMS/CRM or OEM integrations; marketplaces or partner ecosystems; AI-enabled products.

**Our Recruitment Process:**

* 30-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
* Interview with the VP Engineering - Platform (hiring manager).
* Technical interview with our platform architect.
* Interview with our Platform Product Director.

**What We Offer:**

We understand that **flexibility and trust** are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* **Remote Work:** Up to 3 days a week!
* **Work-life balance:** We have flexible entrance and departure time.
* **Summer schedule on Fridays:** Start early your weekends!
* **Referral Bonus:** €1500 for every talent you refer (after 6 months).
* **Flexible Remuneration:** COBEE platform.
* **️ Private Medical Insurance:** Adeslas.
* **Continuous Learning:** Access to our internal platform for continuous development.
* **Vacation:** 23 vacation days plus an intensive schedule in July and August.
* **Teambuilding:** Our afterworks and activities are memorable!

**Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging**

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where **everyone feels valued and respected**. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

* **Support for people with disabilities.** If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
* **Equal opportunities for all:** We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join **Nextlane** and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.

Discover why we are a great place to develop your talent!

We strive for a safe and respectful workplace for all team members and we’re transparent about the measures we are taking to do so. For this reason, Ubisoft’s Code of Conduct has been released publicly on our corporate website for all current and future team members.

Do you want to join us in the world of mobile gaming? If so, read on!

 **Job Description**

Ubisoft Barcelona Mobile is currently seeking a **Senior Data Analyst / Data Scientist** to help our team on their next adventure.

You will support insight initiatives for our Data and Analytics team across the modern data stack (Redshift, dbt, Power BI, GitLab) to turn raw data into decisions, and will be reporting to our Director of Data & Analytics.

**\*Please note that a work permit for Spain obtained prior to applying for the position is mandatory.\***

**Your daily adventure:**

* Turning data into actionable insights, by performing hands-on research, data exploration and analysis, to drive decisions and strategies for user acquisition, retention, and monetization.
* Work with the game teams to provide insights into user behaviour, answer key business questions and support A/B test design and analysis.
* Build and maintain reliable, well-documented data models and pipelines that the wider organization can trust and self-serve from.
* Carry out projects in machine learning for behavioural segmentation and monetization.
* Design, build and maintain clear, actionable Power BI dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the studio.
* Debug and problem-solve issues to ensure the delivery of accurate and clear analysis, reports, and tools — versioning your work in GitLab following good CI/CD practices.
* Effectively communicate results and insights to senior stakeholders throughout the organization.
* Coordinate, challenge and share the best analytical practices and methods within the organization.
* Explore and prototype applications of AI and Generative AI (LLMs, AI agents, copilots) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting, and uncover new player insights.
* Stay up to date with the latest developments in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI/GenAI trends.
* Contribute to the knowledge base and culture of the team.

 **Qualifications**

**YOUR SKILLS**

* Master's degree in a quantitative field (i.e. Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science...). PhD in any of these disciplines is a plus.
* 5+ years of relevant work experience in similar positions, ideally in the mobile gaming industry.
* Highly proficient in SQL as well as Python for data exploration and analysis.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-based data warehouses, ideally Amazon Redshift, and data transformation tools such as dbt.
* Solid experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI (or similar BI tools).
* Comfortable working with version control (Git/GitLab) as part of the daily analytics workflow.
* Robust understanding of advanced statistics suitable for the analysis of skewed populations.
* Experience designing effective ways of communicating, visualising and reporting results/analysis.
* Experience in predictive analytics and segmentation.
* Excellent problem-solving capabilities with strong attention to detail.

**Nice to Have:**

* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to speed up analysis, coding, or documentation.
* Exposure to applying Generative AI / LLMs to analytics use cases (e.g. natural-language querying, automated insight generation, player-facing chat experiences).
* Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum, Kanban, XP) and project management tools (e.g. JIRA).
* Software engineering best practices beyond Git, such as CI/CD pipelines and code review.
* Self-motivation, organizational skills, team spirit, proactivity.
* Passion for games. Interest in mobile F2P games.

 **Additional Information**

**YOUR LIFE AT UBISOFT BARCELONA MOBILE (and PERKS)**

* **Flexible working hours:** 40-hour workweek with start times between 8 AM and 10 AM (or from 7:30 AM when working onsite to avoid traffic jams), and early leave from 4 PM (Fridays from 2 PM).

title: AI and Software Solutions Architect (Remote, Contract)
description:
**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

* We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
* We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.
* At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
* From there on, it's decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.  
    
  INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy

We are looking for an AI & Software Solutions Architect to guide architectural decisions across INFUSE's products and teams. You will review solutions built by internal teams and external vendors, establish shared engineering standards, guide legacy modernisation, and help ensure that production AI systems are reliable, secure and cost-effective.

As the Software Development department's sole Solutions Architect, you will report directly to the Director of Technology and work across a landscape of 500+ repositories, including backend services, LLM-based products and several legacy systems requiring ongoing modernisation. This is a senior individual contributor role with company-wide technical influence and no direct people management. Success in this role depends on strong technical judgement, clear communication and the ability to influence engineering decisions across teams. Your work will centre on architecture, reviews and cross-project improvements, alongside prototypes and selected hands-on development tasks. Engineering teams will deliver the broader implementation.

### **What you will do:**

* Translate business needs into architectural decisions, explaining trade-offs, costs and risks and balancing technical quality with delivery priorities.
* Review code, architecture and vendor deliverables. Produce concise, actionable findings, prioritise improvements, and verify that critical issues have been resolved.
* Establish shared standards across projects, including security, documentation, service contracts and observability, and guide teams in adopting them.
* Define guardrails for production LLM and agentic systems, covering evaluation, prompt management, model routing, multi-provider access, security and cost control.
* Guide legacy modernisation initiatives, including application decomposition, authorisation modernisation, workflow migration and safe transition planning.
* Work with engineering and DevOps teams to advance Kubernetes adoption, improve deployment workflows and observability, and diagnose architectural bottlenecks.
* Build prototypes and reference implementations to validate decisions, and conduct technical interviews for engineering hires.

### **What you will bring:**

* 5+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years owning architectural decisions for production systems as an architect, principal engineer or technical lead, with experience taking solutions from initial concept through implementation to production.
* Strong computer science and system design fundamentals for scalable, high-load distributed systems, including reliability, failure handling, observability and architectural trade-offs.
* Hands-on AWS experience designing and running production services, plus practical Kubernetes experience and the ability to work closely with DevOps on deployment and operational improvements.
* Experience delivering production LLM-based solutions, with an understanding of their lifecycle from business need and design through implementation and operation. Relevant experience includes RAG, tool calling, multi-provider integrations and cost optimisation.
* Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems across quality, latency and cost using observability and evaluation tooling such as Langfuse or similar platforms.
* Experience reviewing other teams' code and architecture and guiding legacy modernisation or migrations.
* A strong software engineering background, preferably with substantial Python and/or Node.js experience, and the flexibility to review and work across different stacks, including legacy PHP.
* Experience with PostgreSQL and NoSQL design and query optimisation, and asynchronous, event-driven systems using Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar brokers.
* Practical experience using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or similar, with sound judgement about verifying generated code and assessing proposed changes.
* Clear technical writing and communication with engineers and non-technical stakeholders. You connect technical decisions to business goals, cost, risk and measurable outcomes, take responsibility for their consequences, and adjust your approach based on evidence.
* B2 or higher English for collaboration with distributed teams.

### **Nice to have:**

* Experience with AIOps: applying AI to operational workflows, including anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage and observability.
* Understanding when classical ML is more appropriate than an LLM, and experience with MLOps.
* Experience with Keycloak or Azure AD SSO migrations.
* Experience with Backstage.
* Experience conducting vendor delivery audits.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional or Anthropic Claude certification.

### **We offer:**

* We offer a competitive salary tailored to the candidate's experience and skills. Payments are processed monthly (USD)
* Full Remote. Work schedule: Monday-Friday, from 1:00 pm to 9:00 pm EEST (incl. 60-min breaks)
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions
* Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions
* Long-term B2B collaboration
* Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays
* Reduced Fridays during the summer
