title: Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Copy & Content
description:
**About Darkroom**
==================

**Darkroom** is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**Location:** Fully remote from Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Mexico, Argentina and Colombia only - supporting a team in the EST time zone.

**About the role**
==================

We are looking for a sharp, fast, brand-obsessed Retention Specialist to own the voice of a high-growth consumer technology client. You will write the email and SMS copy that carries the program, direct the creative that goes with it, and keep the marketing calendar moving as output scales.

You are writing a program into existence rather than maintaining one. The list starts near 20,000 and grows fast behind a significant acquisition investment, volume ramps to 40–60 emails a month, and deepening segmentation multiplies the number of versions behind every send. Most of what you write is automated — lead capture, welcome series, first-conversion and activation sequences — and then loyalty and repeat purchase programming on top of it. The program runs on enterprise tooling such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, or Customer.io.

This is a copy-led role. You will write more than you manage, and the quality of your writing is the primary thing we are hiring for. The ability to hold a consistent voice across a lot of output is essential.

**You should apply if this sounds like you**
============================================

You are a copywriter who happens to work in lifecycle marketing. You can explain a technical product simply, write a subject line that earns the open, and make a subscription upgrade feel like a good idea rather than a sales pitch.

* 3–5+ years of experience writing marketing copy, with meaningful time in email, SMS, or lifecycle marketing. A strong portfolio matters as much as the years.
* You write excellent short-form copy — subject lines, preheaders, body, CTAs, SMS — and you can show work where your copy moved a number.
* You can make consumer technology, software, or a digital subscription feel clear and desirable without jargon. Experience writing for a SaaS, app, or connected-device brand is a strong plus.
* You have written the funnel: lead capture and opt-in copy, welcome series, first-conversion and onboarding sequences, and subscription activation messaging.
* You have written loyalty, rewards, and win-back programming, and you understand that driving repeat purchase and long-term value is a core outcome of this role.
* You are comfortable working from a segmentation strategy, writing distinct copy for distinct audiences rather than one message for everyone.
* You can direct design. You write clear creative briefs, give specific and useful feedback on layout, hierarchy, and imagery, and you know when a design is not serving the copy.
* You are fluent in Figma — you review and approve designs there, leave actionable comments, and keep versions straight.
* You own a marketing calendar with confidence: you can hold a high-volume calendar, flag conflicts early, and keep a lot of moving pieces on schedule.
* You are detail-obsessed about proofing, links, personalization tokens, and brand consistency. Typos in a send genuinely bother you.
* You take feedback well and iterate quickly, and you are comfortable presenting and defending your creative choices to a client.
* Working knowledge of an enterprise ESP (Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, Customer.io, or comparable) is a plus; you do not need to be the one building, but you should understand what is possible.

**A day in the life**
=====================

* Write the email and SMS copy for campaigns, flows, and automations across your client's program, from lead capture through activation, loyalty, and repeat purchase.
* Develop and maintain the client's marketing calendar, sequencing campaigns against the strategy your Associate Director sets and flagging capacity risks before they become problems.
* Write creative briefs for the design team and give clear, specific direction on what each asset needs to do.
* Review and approve designs in Figma, leaving actionable feedback and shepherding assets to final.
* Own the brand voice and the copy guidelines for your client, keeping tone consistent as output scales and segmentation multiplies the number of versions.
* Partner with the CRM Specialist to make sure copy, segmentation logic, and dynamic content line up in the build.
* Proof every send before it goes out — copy, links, personalization, rendering.
* Review performance with your Associate Director and translate what you learn into your next round of copy tests.

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
======================================

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
**Nebius Academy** (powered by TripleTen) provides assessments and training for tech companies and aspiring professionals worldwide, helping companies & individuals transform their lives through career development and acquiring the new skills needed as a tech professional.

Our focus on data science, machine learning, and generative AI helps tech-forward companies level up their employees' skills and drive innovation.

We are looking for an **Application Security Engineer** to own product security end to end — from threat modelling and secure design reviews to vulnerability management and security controls embedded into CI/CD.

You will work closely with product and platform teams to make security part of the engineering process, building secure defaults and helping prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production without slowing development down.

  
Requirements:
  

* 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least 2 years focused on Application Security or Product Security.
* Strong software engineering background with the ability to read, review, and write production code; Python experience is highly preferred.
* Deep practical knowledge of web application security, including OWASP Top 10, ASVS, authentication and session management, OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML, and authorization issues such as IDOR and broken access control.
* Experience securing multitenant or B2B SaaS products, including tenant isolation, RBAC / ABAC, and access control models.
* Hands-on experience embedding security into CI/CD, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, container scanning, and IaC scanning.
* Strong experience with threat modelling, secure design reviews, and secure code reviews in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
* Experience managing vulnerabilities based on risk, criticality, and exploitability, including remediation prioritisation and escalation when needed.
* Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes security, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and auditors.
* Fluent Russian and English at B2 level or above.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience building a DevSecOps practice from scratch.
* Experience running or participating in a Security Champions programme.
* Hands-on penetration testing experience.
* Experience securing LLM-powered or AI products.
* Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective.
* Knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOMs, SLSA, image signing, or similar practices.

  
Brand:
  
Nebius Academy  
  
What you will do:
  

* Own application and product security end to end, from design reviews and threat modelling to vulnerability remediation and follow-up.
* Partner with product and platform teams to embed security into the development lifecycle rather than treat it as a final review step.
* Build and improve security controls in CI/CD, including SAST, dependency, secrets, container, and IaC scanning.
* Review application designs and code where security risk is meaningful, and turn recurring findings into secure defaults, shared libraries, lint rules, and CI gates.
* Drive vulnerability management across application code and cloud posture, including triage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation timelines, and external pentest findings.
* Strengthen security in multitenant B2B systems, including tenant isolation, authentication, authorization, RBAC / ABAC, and access controls.
* Work on cloud and Kubernetes security across AWS environments, including IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and workload hardening.
* Help translate GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements into practical engineering controls and system properties.
* Develop and support a security champions programme to help engineering teams adopt secure practices in their day-to-day work.
* Address security risks specific to AI and LLM-powered features, including prompt injection, data leakage, and untrusted model output.

  
What we can offer you:
  

* A supportive and proactive work environment.
* Competitive compensation: 4000-6000 EUR Gross per month
* Fully remote and full-time collaboration.
* Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.
* Tangible results measured by student success.

description:

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - **Sign****Now, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms** - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.

We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the **United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines**.

At airSlate, we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

**About Marketing team:**

The marketing team handles comprehensive 360º communication and comprises over 150 people. We manage all aspects in-house and operate a robust automation engine. Our combined monthly traffic across all brands exceeds 31 million. As a marketing team member, you'll play a crucial role in the upcoming phase of our brand's growth as we expand and introduce new products to the market.

And now, we are looking for a **Senior Email Operations Team Manager** who is prepared to contribute to the next chapter of our company's growth.

### **What you'll be working on:**

*Strategic*

* Own email-channel-driven attributed revenue as a business outcome, setting the strategic direction for how email contributes to LTV, retention, and expansion across airSlate products
* Define email and push notification strategy in line with product and marketing strategies
* Lead churn-prevention and win-back initiatives across email and push notifications as coordinated, signal-driven programs rather than one-off campaigns
* Set the email roadmap for 2026 and beyond — audit existing programs, identify gaps and quick wins, and prioritize initiatives across three products against attributed revenue targets
* Define how email fits within multi-channel orchestration, establishing boundaries and handoffs between email, in-product messaging, and other channels

*Data & use of data*

* Translate behavioral signals, predictive churn scores, and lifecycle stage classifications into actionable segmentation logic and program triggers
* Define data requirements for email programs — specify the user signals, cohort definitions, and event triggers needed from the data engineering team, and own those requests
* Own the team's contribution to the revenue attribution model — partner with data teams to define lifecycle-stage KPIs and validate that email is correctly credited under the new attribution framework
* Own email dashboards with the data team and align them with lifecycle dashboards, so attribution reporting accurately reflects email's contribution to revenue at each funnel stage
* Use generative and agentic AI tooling to drive personalization and automation at scale across a large, multi-product subscriber base

*Operational*

* Manage and develop three email marketing specialists — set priorities, coach on execution quality, and connect daily work to strategic lifecycle goals
* Coordinate across the email development team, data team, demand gen, and product stakeholders to deliver lifecycle programs end-to-end within airEML
* Maintain and evolve automated email journeys across all four products, with the authority to rebuild or retire programs where data supports it
* Ensure email deliverability and list health at scale across a large, multi-product subscriber base

### **What we expect from you:**

* 5+ years in email marketing as a senior contributor or leader, retention marketing, or lifecycle marketing with an email focus — B2C or B2B SaaS/subscription products at scale preferred
* Proven ownership of an email and/or retention/lifecycle program end-to-end — strategy, journey design, segmentation logic, and KPI ownership, not only execution
* Familiarity with attribution models, including how attribution windows affect reported email performance and how to navigate model transitions
* Experience using behavioral data and predictive models for segmentation, such as churn scoring or lifecycle stage classification
* Hands-on experience with a major marketing automation or email platform (Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, Marketo, HubSpot, or an internal equivalent)
* A track record of cross-functional collaboration with Product and Data Science teams, not siloed within Marketing
* Strategic thinking at the program level, not only the campaign level
* Strong analytical skills, including comfort with dashboards and data-warehouse-sourced data, and the ability to derive lifecycle insights independently
* Understanding of email deliverability and list health at scale (100K+ subscriber base)
* A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Upper-Intermediate (B2) or higher English, written and spoken

* Experience in a multi-product or multi-brand environment

title: Head of Product
description:
Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

We're looking for a Head of Product to partner with our CEO and own the product vision across our app portfolio, from the first idea to scale.

**About the Role:**
===================

As Head of Product, you'll be the CEO's closest partner in deciding what we build next and how our existing apps grow. You'll set the product strategy, run a data-driven decision culture, and build the product team that carries it out. This is a **hands-on leadership role:** you'll set direction and still get into the data, the experiments and the details of the experience.

**What you'll own**
===================

* **Product strategy and portfolio:** define the vision and roadmap across our apps, deciding where to invest, what to launch, and what to sunset.
* **New app launches:** lead ideation, validation and 0 1 launches with the CEO, with clear kill/scale criteria.
* **Growth and monetization:** own the metrics that matter (activation, retention, conversion, ARPU, LTV/CAC) and drive them with a strong experimentation program.
* **Experimentation culture:** set the standards for A/B testing, onboarding and paywall experiments, and make sure decisions are based on solid evidence.
* **Team building:** hire, mentor and lead product managers and analysts as we grow
* **Cross-functional leadership:** align engineering, design and marketing around clear priorities, and ship fast without sacrificing quality.
* **Product quality:** hold a high bar for UX and craft in everything we release.
* **AI-native ways of working:** use AI tools to speed up research, prototyping and analysis, and bring those practices to the team.

**About You:**
==============

* Solid experience building products, including consumer mobile apps.
* 0 1 experience: you've taken a product from idea to real traction.
* A proven track record of moving key metrics (retention, monetization, LTV), with numbers to back it up.
* Strong analytical foundation: SQL, statistics, experiment design, and fluency in unit economics (CAC, LTV, ARPU, payback).
* Experience leading and mentoring people, with a clear ambition to build and lead a team
* High agency and comfortable working directly with founders at startup speed
* Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take full ownership of products.
* A sharp eye for UX. You care about how a product feels, not just how it performs. Passion for UI/UX and Apple-like product experiences.
* Strong proficiency with AI tools to accelerate your workflow.
* Degree in a quantitative or technical field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or similar).

**What we Offer:**
==================

* The opportunity to work side by side with serial entrepreneurs who've built and exited at the highest level.
* A real path to becoming a product leader, working directly with the CEO.
* Attractive compensation package, above market average.
* Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office.
* A fast-moving, AI-native environment where shipping beats talking.

**Hiring Process**
==================

* **TA Interview** – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.
* **CEO** – Deep dive into your product thinking, experience, and fit with the team.
* **Technical Case** – Practical exercise to assess your product, analytical, and strategic capabilities.

====================

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

description:

### **Goodwall**

Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.

Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.

As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.

### **Your Role**

You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.

Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.

### **What you will do**

* **Scale a product members love returning to.** Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
* **Accelerate member acquisition.** Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
* **Bring Product and Growth together.** Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.
* **Set the standard for every detail.** Take responsibility for the quality of the entire member experience, from the clarity of a notification and the simplicity of a product flow to the strength of an ad hook. Combine sharp copy, thoughtful design and precise execution.
* **Experiment with purpose.** Speak with members, understand where they lose interest and test ways to keep them engaged. Run A/B tests, assess retention over time and use the findings to decide what to scale, improve or stop.
* **Hire and lead a strong team.** Choose priorities, develop your people and direct budget toward lasting growth. Move quickly, remove obstacles and take responsibility for results.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive** **compensation** and **equity**: an ownership stake in a scale up raising its Series B.
* Real **authority** across Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with the founders.
* The opportunity to hire and lead **your** **own** **team**.
* An **established** **global** **community** and the chance to shape the experience of millions more members.
* And most importantly, a **mission to be proud** **of** - helping millions of young people build skills, access opportunity and shape their futures

### **What You Bring**

* **You know how to scale.** You have personally helped scale a digital product serving millions, ideally where what worked early stopped working and needed new methods. You can explain what you owned, what you changed, and the results.
* **Depth in product growth.** You have shipped experiments that improved retention and referrals alongside acquisition. Experience in Social, Gaming or EdTech is particularly relevant.
* **Ownership and urgency.** You take ownership of the outcome, move with urgency and follow through with intensity. You find ways forward with limited resources and stay close enough to the work to solve problems yourself.
* **Instinctive Gen Z fluency.** You live and breathe the platforms, creators, communities and formats shaping how Gen Z communicates. You know what earns attention, what gets shared and what feels forced.
* **Exceptional attention to detail.** You recognise strong design and sharp copy, and notice the friction others miss. You care about the small decisions that make an experience feel effortless.
* **Analytical and creative judgment.** You can interpret a retention curve, improve a creator brief and work through a product decision with engineers.
* **Commitment to the mission.** You want to use your expertise to transform lives. Helping millions of young people gain skills, confidence and access to opportunity is work you are ready to invest yourself in.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-260918 **Date posted** 09/30/2026

The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will provide scientific and clinical input to all aspects of late-stage product development and AI-assisted ways of working. This includes but is not limited to the design, delivery, and interpretation of pivotal clinical trials and of studies that further characterize the overall benefit and risk and value of products in respiratory and immunology therapeutic area (TA) in late-stage development. In this role the scientist will seek input from the appropriate functional experts and will coordinate these activities in support of clinical studies and programs.

The Global Development Scientist in Clinical Development and AI will work to ensure that the safety evaluation process for phase II/III trials is seamless and complete, and develop and deploy AI solutions to assist this aim.

The objectives of the Global Development Scientist will be set by the Global Clinical Program Lead (GCPL) in agreement with Global Clinical Head (GCH).

The role will have a special focus on late-stage clinical trials within the Respiratory TA where the Global Development Scientist will work in close collaboration with the study team physician, sites, and other cross-function stakeholders in Respiratory and the wider AI community with all aspects of scientific input, clinical data quality metrics and safety evaluation.

Alongside delivery of the role’s established scientific and clinical responsibilities, the Global Development Scientist will act as a lead for selected AI-enabled use cases—identifying high-value opportunities, translating clinical needs into clear requirements, piloting solutions in live studies, piloting and evaluating workflows, and supporting adoption at scale.

A key purpose of the role is to support the deployment of AI-assisted methods that maintain/enhance quality whilst accelerating the design, conduct, data review and interpretation; ensuring the retention of accountable human scientific and clinical judgement and analysis of clinical trials. Always ensuring that the novel AI solutions deployed follow appropriate governance processes and maintain the standards of Good Clinical Practice (GCP). All of this with the ultimate goal of helping to bring new treatments to patients.

The role will connect clinical domain expertise with AI capabilities. It will help establish reusable approaches rather than isolated pilots, with success assessed through evidence of adoption and measurable improvements in clinical development outcomes, quality, efficiency or cycle time.

You will be expected to collaborate effectively with colleagues in late-stage Respiratory groups, and to build productive connections. You will combine strong scientific judgement with curiosity about emerging AI methods, communicate benefits and limitations clearly, and support colleagues to use approved tools confidently and responsibly. You will present scientific and AI-enabled insights to multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders and contribute as a member of a diverse, motivated team spanning multiple divisions of Biopharmaceuticals R&D.

**Typical Accountabilities**

* Provide scientific leadership in the innovative design, execution and interpretation of clinical trials in one or more development programs.

* Effectively collaborate with colleagues in other functions including Patient Safety, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, and early development groups.

* Be involved primarily in late stage (PhIIb and Phase III) clinical programs and to collaborate with clinical colleagues supporting early-stage programs as well as medical affairs colleagues.

* Provide expert scientific input into the preparation of regulatory documents and interactions with regulatory authorities.

* Provide expert scientific review, analysis, and interpretation of data from ongoing studies and in the literature.

* Lead development of quality metrics and data review plan for assigned studies.

* Identify and prioritise clinical development activities where AI assistance can add meaningful value, define the clinical problem and intended outcome, and agree fit-for-purpose success measures with study and functional partners, including stakeholder alignment, workflow integration, user feedback, training, adoption monitoring and transition from pilot to sustained use

* Support and contribute to medical monitoring of trials.

* Lead and participate in activities that ensure quality, consistency and integration of clinical study related deliverables and ensure safety evaluation process within the clinical team.

* Provide clinical leadership for the testing and validation of AI-assisted outputs, ensuring appropriate human review, traceability, data quality, privacy, security and compliance with applicable quality and regulatory expectations, embedding fit-for-purpose methods into study and programme workflows

* Ensure scientific input to TA standards.

* Provide scientific evidence to support strategic decision making for R&D, marketing, clinical, and business development departments.

* Present protocol and scientific results to multidisciplinary teams and key stakeholders

* Develop and review protocols, informed consent, investigator’s brochure and other clinical development documents.

* Organize and analyse data from clinical research to build new hypothesis.

* Support upskilling in AI-assisted ways of working and contribute to the development of AI capability across Respiratory Clinical Development and engage with AI user networks and relevant cross-functional initiatives to share learning, promote reuse and scale effective AI-assisted practices.

**Education, Qualifications, Skills, and Experience**

* Relevant university degree with extensive experience from clinical development.

* Three or more years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience (multi-country clinical trials) is required.

* Understanding of scientific and clinical issues related to the design and implementation of clinical trials and interpreting trial results particularly in respiratory and immunology clinical development.

* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional setting.

* Experience particularly in Phase II and Phase III clinical development.

* Experience using AI technologies and building or deploying AI solutions in a work environment, with demonstrated competence applying AI in clinical, biomedical or drug development settings

description:
What's the role about?:

**Client Relationship Manager**

**Location:** Farringdon, London EC1  
**Contract:** Permanent, Full Time (Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours/week)  
**Salary:** Competitive basic + OTE

We are hiring Client Relationship Managers to own a portfolio of brands: protect it, renew it and grow it.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Own the relationship. You are the single commercial owner for your accounts, trusted at VP and director level and multi-threaded across marketing, ecommerce and procurement.
* Protect and renew. Run every renewal as a project from six months out, with a plan, a value story and a stakeholder map, so nothing is left to the last month.
* Prove the value. Deliver quarterly business reviews built on performance data, and turn insight into the next decision for the client.
* Grow the book. Spot the upgrade, the new market and the new product fit, and close it.
* Keep the record straight. Account plans, pipeline and renewal dates current in Salesforce, every week.

You will also own accounts worth £500k+ a year, lead renewals and tenders with procurement, handle multi-market contracts and mentor newer CRMs.

**What good looks like in year one:**

* Your renewals land on time and at value, with the groundwork done early.
* Your clients can say what Flixmedia has done for them, with numbers.
* Your book is bigger at the end of the year than at the start.

**What You'll Bring To The Role:**

* Experience owning enterprise accounts in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing or ecommerce, with annual account value of £100k+ (Senior: £500k+).
* A record of retaining and growing accounts, not only closing them.
* Confidence in senior client meetings and in a negotiation with procurement.
* Comfort with performance data and a clear way of turning it into a client story.
* Organisation to run several accounts and deadlines at once without dropping any.
* Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

### **What You’ll Get In Return:**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
* Contributory Pension, Death In Service
* 24 days holiday (rising to 27) + bank holidays + birthday day off!
* Health perks: Medicash scheme, wellbeing apps (Calm, WeCare) and enhanced sick, maternity and parental pay
* Exclusive discounts: Perkbox, Tastecard
* Flexible working environment, including opportunities for remote work
* A collaborative, high-performance culture with significant opportunities for growth

### **Why Flixmedia?**

We’re at the heart of the eCommerce boom — helping global brands supercharge online sales through smart content and technology. Join a driven, talented team where your impact will be seen and celebrated.

**Ready to make moves?** Apply now and let’s grow together.

**Eligibility:** Only candidates eligible to work in the UK without visa sponsorship now or in the future need apply.

More about us...:

**What do we do?**  
At Flixmedia, we connect the world's top brands to the largest retailers across the globe and through the power of content syndication we enrich eCommerce shopper experiences. Armed with 17 years of experience in the e-commerce technology industry, our strengths lie in combining content, the latest technologies and our vast global retailer network to turn browsers into buyers. Our reach spans a network of 1600+ retailers across 90+ countries serving content and experiences from +100 of the world’s largest brands to billions of shoppers.

**Our Vision**  
Flixmedia exists to bring brands and retailers closer to their customers by offering a more informed and engaging shopper experience driven by data and enriched through innovative technologies. We continually invest and improve our products to deliver value over the long term for our clients across the globe.

**What you’re getting into**:  
At Flixmedia, our culture is driven by the value we provide, we combine years of experience with our hunger for constant innovation within the eCommerce space. Our values are driven by a combination of our people, products and passion. We value our people for who they are and for their knowledge, skills and experience as individuals and team members. We don’t want to be complacent and accept the status quo - we want to aim for more and embrace creativity when it comes to building our products and culture. We don’t always know the answer, but chances are, we are going to do our research and find out. Curiosity helps us constantly improve our offerings to be the trailblazers and never get left behind.

A fast-paced environment where everyone is focussed on succeeding – for the team, for themselves and for the business. Cross-functionally and throughout the company, everyone has common goals and aspires to be their best. With so many smart and creative people around and you’ll be motivated to pursue your ideals. At Flixmedia we challenge conventional wisdom refusing to accept that something cannot be done.

title: Senior Auditor - Property & Casualty Actuarial (Hybrid; m/f/x/d), Madrid (M, ES)
description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty Actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organisational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team in Madrid, where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and a genuine opportunity to influence topics of organisational significance.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Auditor specialising in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's risk assurance function — leading audits across the (re)insurance value chain with a focus on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements. This is a role where your actuarial expertise meets strategic impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead and deliver** a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.
* **Evaluate the effectiveness** of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.
* **Identify and assess** key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain, keeping Swiss Re ahead of the curve.
* **Engage and challenge** senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and sound decision-making.
* **Coach and support** team members, sharing your expertise and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing audit team.
* **Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture** at Swiss Re, reinforcing the value of independent, objective assurance.

**About the Team**

Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives. As part of this team, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are passionate about making a real difference to the organisation.

**About You**

You're a detail-oriented Property & Casualty (P&C) actuary with strong analytical skills and the confidence to challenge established practices. You excel at translating complex actuarial concepts into meaningful business insights and can communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. You're passionate about risk management and eager to contribute to Swiss Re's resilience through independent, objective assessment.

**We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:**

* Nearly qualified or fully qualified P&C actuary
* 7+ years of experience in the insurance and/or reinsurance industry
* Strong experience in P&C reserving and/or pricing methodologies
* Solid understanding of emerging risks and trends in the P&C (re)insurance industry
* Solid understanding of IFRS 17 and/or US GAAP governance, processes, and controls

**These are additional nice to haves:**

* Experience in internal audit or risk management functions
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks applicable to (re)insurance companies
* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Project management skills and experience leading small teams

For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between 56 000 EUR and 94 000 EUR for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

* The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
* The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Furthermore, you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**

**Please upload your CV in English.**

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.
  
  
During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: Mobility ITS Engineer
description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.

  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

The CoE for Mobility & Digital Infrastructure (CoE4M) leads Ferrovial Innovation's work at the intersection of data, technology, and mobility - spanning connected and autonomous transport, digital tolling, mobility platforms, AI-enabled infrastructure, and emerging transport technologies incl. physical and embodied AI. It also provides specific support to Cintra, Ferrovial’s concession division providing Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS) and tolling technical support.

  

This is a mid-level role requiring equal emphasis on self-led technical and analytical delivery and collaborative facilitation across teams, business units, and external partners. The role covers both mobility innovation development and ITS/tolling technical support. Programming and AI-augmented working is the default method, not an afterthought.

  

This position will report to the ITS Lead or directly to the Head of CoE. From time-to-time, as needed, the role may be assigned to specific projects that require a more complex matrix management structure.

The working place is as per above, but the role may require travelling during short periods of time to other places nationally or internationally. There might also be opportunity/requirement for 2 – 6 month long secondments in other territories, including the US.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Business Unit Partnership**

* Partner with BU teams to identify innovation opportunities, co-develop initiatives, and support operational adoption.

* Represent CoE4M in workshops, project briefings, and stakeholder outreach, translating BU needs into requirements.

* Coordinate with wider Ferrovial Innovation team to align initiatives and cross-pollinate findings across business lines.

* Brief stakeholders on initiative status/outcomes as needed; represent Ferrovial at external industry events and forums.

**Prototyping & Technical Delivery**

* Run hands-on data analysis, technology assessments, and prototypes end-to-end, from concept to proof-of-value.

* Use AI tools/platforms as core working practice for tech dev/integration, modelling and structured deliverables.

* Build business cases (revenue, cost, and risk models) to support scoping and prioritization decisions.

* Scope and coordinate resources (internal & external) where a prototype/initiative requires additional capability.

**ITS/Tolling Technical Support**

* Provide technical design input, cost estimates, and budget quotes for ITS and tolling supporting bids and concessions.

**Market Intelligence & Scouting**

* Monitor and synthesize developments in data-driven, automated, and autonomous ITS/Tolling/mobility into insights.

* Evaluate vendors/OEMs/products against defined business priorities; initiate and manage engagement as required.

* Capture knowledge, contacts, and ideas from workshops/events/meetings into written summaries for internal reuse.

* Produce technology briefs, white papers, bid content, and presentation materials from the above intelligence.
* **Knowledge Sharing**
Contribute findings and outputs to the Ferrovial Innovation Community, ensuring visibility across business lines.  

**Qualifications**

  

**Required**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer/Data Science, or equivalent quantitative/technical discipline or experience.

* 2+ years working directly with transport technologies and infrastructure — e.g., ITS, tolling systems (open-road/all-electronic tolling, interoperability standards), traffic management systems or C-V2X/V2X connected-vehicle platforms.

* Proven advanced level programming experience, preferably Python, C/C++ or similar

* Practical, hands-on fluency with AI tools beyond consumer chat interfaces — e.g., using LLM APIs or agentic platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Copilot Studio) to build structured workflows, using AI-assisted coding for data pipelines or prototypes (Python/SQL preferred), or applying AI to geospatial data/imagery analysis for infra monitoring.

* Fluent in MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Copilot).

* Able to engage credibly with stakeholders at manager/director level.

* Excellent English required; professional Spanish highly desirable.

Willingness to travel periodically (domestic and international). Valid passport and driving licence.(B1).  

  

**What are we looking for**

* Technically & commercially grounded: genuine curiosity about how data/tech/AI is reshaping mobility and able to engage with both technical and commercial dimensions and stakeholders.

* Digitally fluent: you actively seek and utilize digital/AI tools that improve the quality and speed of your outputs.

* Analytical communicator: able to synthesise complexity into clear, structured outputs for varied audiences.

* Dual-mode contributor: equally effective as an independent technical contributor and as a collaborative facilitator.

Pragmatic and delivery-focused: entrepreneurial mindset with a clear bias toward action and tangible output.  

  

**Desirable**

* Knowledge for the design and deployment of communications networks

* Hands-on experience on the usage of development boards (e.g. arduino, raspberry-pi)

* Hardware configuration, management and integration (e.g. cameras, lidars, switches, servers)

* Experience in an innovation, digital, technology, AI, or data-focused role within a corporate or consulting environment.

* Working knowledge of mobility data standards and formats relevant to analytics and system integration.

* Demonstrated interest and working knowledge of connected/autonomous mobility, digital tolling, or mobility analytics; able to speak to eco-system, technologies, and where the sector is heading, not just historical context.

* Track record of project delivery with tangible outputs combining self-led technical work (data analysis, prototyping, modelling) and cross-team collaboration.

* Comfort working across corporate, startup, public sector, or innovation-ecosystem, adapting delivery style accordingly.

* Experience with Earth Observation data (satellite/SAR imagery, platforms like Google Dynamic World or Sentinel Hub) for infrastructure risk, construction monitoring, or asset management use cases.

* Familiarity with Demand Responsive Transport (DRT) systems and/or dynamic/managed-lane management.

* Experience with advanced comms infrastructure (5G, satellite comms) or IoT sensor networks as applied to transport/infrastructure monitoring.

* Exposure to VR/XR for training, simulation, or stakeholder visualization; or early-stage familiarity with quantum computing applications in optimization/logistics.

* Business development, venturing, or financial modelling experience or formal training.

* International professional experience.

**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Wholesale Controller - Temp. Position
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As a Wholesale & Econcession controller, you will be part of our Finance Team based in Madrid and reporting to the Wholesale & Digital Controlling Manager.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Perform the monthly closing for the local company, working closely with the Accounting team on Sales matters: analyze variances and review the P&L (Sales, Margin, and OPEX) for both channels (Wholesale and E-concession), calculate accruals, and provide qualitative commentary.
* Collaborate with other entities (US, APAC, etc.) and perform monthly consolidations to build the worldwide P&L for both channels.
* Support the preparation of ad hoc requests for internal and external stakeholders, including spend analysis, activity tracking by region (CAPEX, Marketing, and Staffing expenses), and monthly closing presentations for executive management.
* Work closely with the business teams, providing support through various analyses (for example, financial modeling for new store openings).
* Coordinate budgeting activities and prepare local P&L forecasts during budgeting and forecasting cycles.
* Participate in transformation projects involving systems and tools such as Anaplan, Esker, and Power BI.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* + 3-5 years of experience in Controlling/FP&A positions (experience in Retail would be a plus)
* Strong analytical and presentation skills
* Be result oriented, highly analytical and organized
* Proficiency in Excel and Power Point are required, and positive valued Power BI.
* Excellent communication skills in English & Spanish
* Proactive, work with tight deadlines

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director – VFX
description:
**Company Description**

Built on legacy. Driven by what’s next.

At El Ranchito, our work comes to life through the unique talent, creativity, and imagination of our people. From our studios in Madrid and Barcelona, we bring some of the biggest stories in film and television to screens everywhere through world-class visual effects.

As part of the Pitch Black network, El Ranchito brings its distinctive creative expertise to a global community of studios, diverse talent, technology, resources, and possibilities.

Join us and help craft the moments audiences remember.

 **Job Description**

El Ranchito is looking for a Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director who combines strong visual judgement with coding and applied machine-learning skills.

Reporting to the Machine Learning Supervisor, this is a hands-on, production-facing role focused on using ML to solve real VFX challenges. The position sits between artistry, pipeline development and applied machine learning: understanding how high-quality visual effects are created while having the technical ability to build, adapt and troubleshoot the tools behind them.

This is not a role focused solely on generating images with existing tools. We are looking for someone who can understand a production problem, investigate possible technical solutions, build or adapt a workflow, evaluate its limitations and help artists use it successfully on real work.

Candidates may come from any VFX department—including compositing, FX or Lighting. Professional experience as a production VFX artist or artist-facing TD is strongly preferred.

Exceptional ML candidates without a traditional VFX background may also be considered if they demonstrate outstanding technical depth, strong visual judgement and highly relevant work in image, video, 3D or other areas directly applicable to VFX production.

The role is open to candidates based in Spain.

 **Qualifications**  

* Professional production experience as a VFX artist or artist-facing TD in at least one department is strongly preferred.
* A strong reel, portfolio or body of work demonstrating visual judgement and technical problem-solving.
* Practical experience applying machine learning, computer vision or generative models to image, video, geometry or related media.
* Strong Python skills and experience creating maintainable production tools.
* Familiarity with Git, APIs, package and environment management, and reproducible development practices.
* Experience with an ML framework such as PyTorch or equivalent.
* A working understanding of model inference, datasets, evaluation, fine-tuning and GPU-based processing.
* Experience integrating tools into at least one major VFX application or production pipeline is highly valued.
* A solid understanding of production imagery, including colour, dynamic range, resolution, compositing requirements and temporal consistency.
* Strong visual judgement and the ability to respond constructively to creative direction.
* A generalist mindset and the ability to move comfortably between creative, technical and pipeline challenges.
* The ability to explain technical ideas and limitations clearly to artists, supervisors and production teams.
* Full professional fluency in spoken and written English, with confidence collaborating across international teams and time zones.
* Candidates must be based within the European Union for the duration of the role. Spain is preferred but not essential.

Candidates without a traditional VFX background may still be considered if they demonstrate an exceptional track record in relevant applied ML work, together with a strong visual portfolio and a clear understanding of the quality and control required for professional image production.

**Valuable Additional Experience**

* Nuke, Houdini, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine or other VFX and DCC applications.
* ComfyUI or other node-based ML workflow systems.
* OpenCV, Diffusers or related computer-vision and generative-media frameworks.
* C++, CUDA or model and inference optimisation.
* Linux, containers, cloud or render-farm infrastructure.
* USD, OpenColorIO, ACES, EXR and high-dynamic-range image workflows.
* Segmentation, matting, tracking, depth estimation, reconstruction, inpainting, relighting, denoising or upscaling.
* Video generation, optical flow and temporal consistency techniques.
* Dataset preparation, model training or distributed inference.
* Artist-facing UI or web development.
* Open-source contributions, publications or research with a clear application to VFX production.

  
**Additional Information**

Please include a CV, reel or portfolio, and examples of relevant technical work.

These may include code samples, open-source contributions, tools, workflow demonstrations or concise case studies explaining the production problem, your individual contribution, the approach taken, its limitations and the final result.

We understand that production work is often confidential. Please do not share restricted material; a clear written breakdown of your role and approach is equally valuable.

**Need Accommodation?**

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience.

**Privacy Notice**

Your personal information will be collected, used, and stored for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

**Pitch Black is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Pitch Black, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, colour, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, provincial, or local law.

title: Executive Associate- [Open to Tier 0, 1 and 2 applicants]
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

* **Tier 0:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* **Tier 1:** Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated:** All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting-edge global perspectives and advocacy.

The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi-stakeholder fora including public-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, South-South and Triangular cooperation initiatives, and engages in UN inter-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts in close coordination and thematic synergy with the Crisis Bureau (CB).

The Front Office of BPPS is responsible for the smooth and seamless management of the substantive flow of information to and from BPPS, coordinating effective internal communications with BPPS teams, other Bureaus, the UNDP Executive Office, as well as communications with external partners. The Front Office plans and coordinates the BPPS Director and BPPS Deputy Director’s internal and external interactions and interventions based on priorities and agendas, in close collaboration with technical teams and other Bureaus as needed, ensuring the Director and Deputy Director’s successful provision of political leadership, strategic guidance, and managerial as well as programmatic priorities in full compliance with UNDP’s mandate.

With the opening of a new UNDP office in Madrid, where the BPPS Deputy Director and a number of BPPS teams will be relocating in the course of 2026, the Executive Associate will play a key role in supporting the establishment and smooth running of the new office, and its efficient interactions with the two other main BPPS locations (New York and Bonn).

**Position Purpose:**

Under the direct supervision of the BPPS Deputy Director and in coordination with their Special Assistant, the Executive Associate ensures that the Deputy Director receives the immediate administrative and operational support needed to execute their managerial functions. The incumbent works closely with both the Special Assistant and the Executive Associate of the Assistant Administrator and Director of BPPS, to strengthen coordination and complementarities in the Office of the Director and contribute toward the overall operations of the Front Office.

As one of the first points of contact with the Bureau for senior UNDP/UN staff and the full range of representatives of UNDP’s constituencies, the Executive Associate must deal with a heavy volume of requests and a wide range of highly sensitive matters under heavy time pressure.

Given the demands of protocol and interaction, often at high levels, the Executive Associate is required to perform the role with a calm demeanor under stressful circumstances, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in personal communication, knowledge of protocol, discretion and independent judgment, motivation and proactive attitude.

**The key functions of the Executive Associate are to ensure:**

* Effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Effective communications support to the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Support for effective relationship management by BPPS Directorate;
* Support the establishment and management of the new UNDP Office in Madrid

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Ensures effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director, focusing on the achievement of the following results:**

* Act as liaison with New York and Bonn BPPS offices in order to optimize the new configuration of BPPS across three main offices;
* Act as point of contact to prepare visits from UNDP leadership, including coordinating with Headquarters on the visit programme, facilitating the necessary travel documents for visas, support to secure UN Grounds Pass where needed, and liaising with counterparts/ Ministries in Spain on logistics and the needful security protocols.
* Acts as logistics coordinator for events involving the Madrid office staff and/or premises (e.g. preparation for official meetings or events hosted in the Madrid office, procurement of services or meeting supplies etc.).

**5. Facilitate knowledge building and management.**

* Provide sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice.

title: Power Systems Innovation Lead
description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.

  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

*What if your next project didn't end up as a slide in a deck, but as technology actually running in an airport, a highway, a solar or wind power plant, or a data center?*

  

We are looking for a hands-on technical innovation leader who can work where energy strategy becomes real infrastructure: storage, grid connection, microgrids, electrification, critical power, resilience and renewable generation. You will assess emerging technologies with rigor, shape practical use cases and lead them through testing and validation, building the evidence the business needs to decide whether to invest, scale or stop.

  

You will join Corporate Innovation and work across Ferrovial’s businesses: Airports, Cintra, Ferrovial Energy and Digital Infrastructure. Success in the role requires strong engineering judgement, the ability to distinguish genuine breakthroughs from incremental improvements, and the credibility to engage technical and business stakeholders alike—translating complex challenges into well-structured pilots, clear investment decisions and scalable business opportunities.

  

This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of infrastructure by bringing cutting-edge technologies from concept to real-world deployment across a global leader in the sector. Experience in mission-critical environments, including data centers, is a plus, but not essential.

  

**Key Responsibilitie** s

* Lead energy, sustainability and resilience projects from technology identification through pilot, business case and scale-up recommendation
* Design and run proofs of concept with business units, OEMs, engineering partners, research centers and startups — setting your own KPIs and decision gates
* Bring real engineering judgment to grid connection, electrification, storage, microgrids, critical power, energy management and renewable generation infrastructure (solar and wind plants)
* Translate complex technical options and uncertainty into clear business cases for senior leadership
* Explore emerging low-carbon technologies — carbon capture and utilization, green molecules, hydrogen, e-fuels, biogenic routes — and assess their real potential
Optionally contribute to projects on low-carbon materials, embodied carbon and circularity  

  

**Qualification** s

* Hold an engineering or equivalent technical degree, ideally in electrical, energy, mechanical, industrial, civil or building-services engineering
* 8–12 years of experience in corporate innovation, technical office roles, or critical asset operations (energy, renewables, infrastructure, data centers)
* Real engineering judgment, not just strategic vision — you can defend a technical decision, not just frame one
* Relevant knowledge of energy and infrastructure systems—including grid connection, electrification, efficiency, storage, microgrids, controls, critical power or energy management—and how they interact with thermal, water and resilience requirements
* Familiarity with low-carbon materials, carbon technologies, embodied carbon, circularity and lifecycle value, with sound judgement on when to involve Ferrovial’s specialist teams
* Ability to build effective relationships across business units and with operators, OEMs, engineering partners, startups, universities and investors, acting as a connector rather than an operational owner
* Ability to move across asset classes: what you learn on a wind farm should be useful on an airport, a highway or a data center
* A drive to see things through: you don't stop at validation — you want to see the technology scale
* Comfort working with uncertainty and with very different stakeholders — from an OEM engineer to a business director

We are not looking for a purely strategic profile without hands-on engineering. Someone who prefers staying in day-to-day operations rather than pushing change forward. Someone who wants to specialize in a single asset class.

**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.
