title: Regional Key Account Manager, Ireland
description:
**Job title: Regional Key Account Manager, Ireland**  
**Department: Group Sales**  
**Contract: Full-time, 12-month fixed-term contract (family leave cover)**

Are you a driven sales professional with a passion for books and a thorough understanding of the Irish book market? Pan Macmillan are looking for a Key Account Manager to drive our regional commercial success and ensure our key Irish customers ‘think Pan Mac first’. In this role, you will lead sales strategy, cultivate trusting trade relationships, and champion local acquisitions and author events across Ireland.

**Your team:**  
You will be joining the collaborative and high-performing Group Sales team, reporting directly to the Ireland Sales Director. Working alongside a local publicity rep, trade marketing, field teams, and our London-based Communications colleagues, you will join a passionate team dedicated to delivering tailored support to our account partners and growing our market presence in creative, impactful ways.

**Your role:**  
As the Key Account Manager, Ireland, you will take ownership of delivering the sales budget across the Irish market. You will act as the key contact for Irish customers – ranging from major key accounts to independent bookshops, wholesalers, and non-traditional retailers – delivering tailored sales presentations, local event support, and strategic account management to maximize growth across frontlist and backlist titles.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* **Drive Regional Revenue:** Deliver the overall sales budget for Ireland through targeted account strategy, proactive backlist campaigns, media opportunities, and seasonal promotions.
* **Key Account & Relationship Management:** Maintain excellent relationships across all direct, wholesale, and non-traditional accounts, conducting strategic sales calls with tailored title presentations and managed account spend.
* **Local Market Strategy & Acquisitions:** Work with Sales Directors to establish priorities for the Irish market, feed back insights for Irish acquisitions, and report on local market trends and competitor activity.
* **Publicity, Events & Local Trade Support:** Work with Publicity and Communications teams to drive high-impact author events, and foster relationships with key bookshops.
* **Operations & Distribution Alignment:** Oversee pricing, format, and metadata accuracy for Irish editions while working closely with Macmillan Distribution to ensure seamless logistics and account order fulfillment.
* **Trade Communication & Marketing:** Boost Pan Macmillan’s presence across the Irish trade by collaborating with trade marketing on newsletters, tailored sell-in sheets, social media, and industry trade shows.

**Essential experience, abilities, knowledge, and values you’ll need to succeed:**

* **Sales & Industry Experience:** Proven sales experience, ideally within publishing, with deep knowledge of the Irish sales territory and bookselling landscape.
* **Commercial & Communication Skills:** Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and communication skills, with proven capability in budget management and title list pitching.
* **Adaptability & Market Passion:** A proactive, flexible approach with a genuine passion for books and awareness of publishing trends across regions.
* **Inclusion and Representation:** An active dedication to promoting diverse voices and inclusive practices, taking personal responsibility for ensuring our workplace and publishing reflect the communities we serve.
* **Community:** A collaborative approach to building a supportive and vibrant environment.
* **Curiosity:** A genuine drive for learning and a readiness to embrace different perspectives.
* **Integrity:** A foundation of openness and honesty, taking responsibility for actions and learning from mistakes.

**Desirable skills we’d love you to have:**

* **Regional Industry Contacts:** Established relationships with key Irish booksellers, wholesalers, and independent trade partners.
* **Event & Campaign Management:** Direct experience with event planning and regional author campaign support.

**What you’ll get in return:**  
In return we can offer you a range of great projects, a supportive and collaborative working environment as well as a competitive salary and benefits package.

**Salary:** €44,500 to €56,000

**Note on salary:**  
The offered salary is dependent on experience and expertise. We benchmark our ranges to ensure fair, competitive compensation that grows with your impact.

**Closing date:** 18 October 2026

This is a full-time, 12-month fixed-term contract. The role is remote/home-based, and candidates must be based in either Northern Ireland or the Republic of Ireland.

**Some of the benefits we offer:**

* 28 days’ annual leave increasing with years of service + bank holidays
* Generous pension scheme
* Enhanced family pay and leave
* Flexible working hours and summer hours (early finish on a Friday during summer months)
* 2 volunteer days per year
* 75% off all Pan Macmillan books and regular staff book sales (highly reduced rates)

**How to apply & eligibility:**

* **Our process:** All applications must be submitted via our careers site to be considered. We are unable to accept CVs or applications sent via email.
* **Our timelines:** Because we review every application thoroughly and with care, our shortlisting process can take some time. We appreciate your patience and will be in touch as soon as we have an update on your application.
* **Right to work:** All applicants must be able to demonstrate the right to live and work in either the UK or Republic of Ireland in order to be considered for this role.

**Our commitment to diversity & inclusion:**  
At Pan Macmillan, we are committed to publishing a wide range of voices that reflect the full breadth of the communities we serve. Joining us means playing an active role in bringing our titles to life as part of a team that champions inclusion at every level. We are dedicated to building a workplace that is as diverse and welcoming as the stories we tell, ensuring all perspectives are celebrated across everything we do.

We welcome applications from all individuals, including any age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion and/or belief. Our efforts to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are ongoing, and we continually strive to learn and improve. You can read our full Diversity, Equity and Inclusion pledge here.

**Disability confident scheme:**  
As a Disability Confident employer, we actively encourage applications from disabled candidates and people with long-term health conditions, aiming to offer an interview to everyone who meets the essential criteria for the role and chooses to apply under the scheme. The essential criteria can be found under our ‘Essential experience, abilities, knowledge and values you’ll need to succeed’ section.

Please note, some of our vacancies attract an exceptionally high volume of applications. In these circumstances, to ensure a fair and focused process for everyone, we may need to limit the overall number of interviews. Where this happens, we will look closely at who most closely aligns with the requirements to select the candidates applying under this scheme who best meet the essential criteria, in line with official government guidance.

Please remember that you are never required to disclose a disability to us, and you only need to share what you feel comfortable with.

**Adjustment & support:**  
We want to ensure that all candidates are supported throughout the recruitment process. If you have any reasonable adjustments or accessibility requirements, please contact Kayelle Danyluk (Head of Talent Acquisition) at kayelle.danyluk@macmillan.com.

**Privacy notice:**  
All personal information which we process in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice here. Please read this notice before submitting your application.

title: Account Director
description:
Overview:

### **Working within Automotive Brands**

This role sits within Haymarket’s specialist Automotive division, championing the dual-brand powerhouse of *What Car?* and *Autocar*. *What Car?* serves as the ultimate, data-driven consumer champion and purchase-funnel tool, while *Autocar* stands as the definitive authority on automotive passion, deep-dive reviews, and industry insight. Together, they deliver market-leading branded experiences, cross-platform media solutions, and lead-generation tools that shape consumer decisions and drive commercial growth for automotive and media agency partners.

**The Role**

The primary purpose of the Account Director is to act as the commercial and strategic lead for key media agencies, serving as the senior point of contact for independent and network partners. In this role, you will nurture strategic agency relationships and translate client marketing objectives into high-impact cross-platform campaigns. By driving multi-channel content partnerships, native advertising, and programmatic data solutions, you add direct value to agency clients while consistently accelerating revenue growth across both iconic automotive titles.

Responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Strategic Relationship Management:** Serve as the primary, senior point of contact for key independent and network media agencies, establishing best-in-class relationships.
* **Consultative Selling:** Interrogate client briefs to develop innovative, multi-channel content partnerships, native advertising, and programmatic data solutions.
* **Commercial Growth:** Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell integrated campaigns across both digital, print, data, lead generation, and podcast sponsorships.
* **Pitch Leadership:** Lead high-level commercial pitches, working closely with ad operations, creative studio, and data teams to build winning, unified proposals.
* **Cross-Department Collaboration:** Oversee the delivery of complex content partnerships by liaising with Project Managers, Editorial Leads, Video Production, and Ad Operations.
* **Performance Optimisation:** Monitor account performance and track campaigns against client KPIs using first-party data and analytics, providing clients with actionable, valuable commercial insights.
* **Market Position Advancement:** Increase the speed of going to market for new products, approaches, and brand opportunities across agency teams.

**Key Relationships**
---------------------

Works closely with Media Agencies, Ad Operations, Creative Studio, Data Teams, Project Managers, and Editorial Leads to build effective working relationships, share knowledge, provide support, and contribute to the successful delivery of business objectives.

Skills / Experience / Knowledge / Minimum Criteria:

**Knowledge, Skills & Experience**
----------------------------------

### **Knowledge**

* Comprehensive knowledge of the media, publishing, or agency ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of commercial sales principles, consultative selling, and customer relationship management.
* Advanced knowledge of digital media channels, including digital display, programmatic advertising, and content partnerships.
* Understanding of dual-brand synergy and positioning distinct audience demographics (e.g., consumer purchase-funnel vs. enthusiast insight).

### **Skills**

* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the gravitas to influence C-suite marketing directors.
* Ability to interpret complex data, Google Analytics, and lead-generation statistics to produce meaningful insights and compelling commercial narratives.
* Strong presentation and pitch-leading capabilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration across multiple internal operational and creative teams.

### **Experience**

* Relevant experience as an Account Director (or Senior Account Manager ready to step up) within a media agency, creative agency, or media publisher.
* Extensive experience in managing, growing, and nurturing senior strategic customer or client relationships.
* Confident in delivering complex multi-channel commercial, media, or marketing projects.
* Proven experience working within a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to build integrated, winning business proposals.

**About You**
-------------

* **Results driven:** Focused on hitting and exceeding milestones and driving brand portfolio growth.
* **Collaborative:** Thrives when working alongside ad ops, creative studio, and production teams to achieve success.
* **Customer focused:** Dedicated to deeply understanding client briefs and maximizing return on investment for agency partners.
* **Accountable:** Takes ownership of revenue targets, strategic communication, and high-level project oversight.
* **Leads by example:** Displays the industry authority and gravitas necessary to build trust with agency networks.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Financial performance against portfolio revenue growth expectations.
* Customer and media agency satisfaction evidenced by strong, best-in-class strategic relationships.
* Operational efficiency in coordinating complex multi-platform campaigns with internal teams.
* Achievement of strategic objectives, including accelerated time-to-market for new advertising products

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

### **Why work with us at Haymarket?**

Haymarket Media Group values its people and strives to shape a better future with remarkable content. From paid content and subscription services; to integrated advertising and content marketing packages. We deliver market-leading branded experiences that inspire great decisions. From data and digital information solutions to live events, awards and professional education services.

**Our Company benefits**

* 25 days holiday per year excluding bank holidays (increasing 1 day per year of service up to 30 days)

* Work from anywhere in the world for up to 3 weeks of the year with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ days
* Flexible working hours (core hours from 10-3) allowing you the flexibility to adapt your work schedule to your personal commitments
* Generous contributory pension scheme
* Health Cash Plans: With our health cash plans, you can access a range of healthcare benefits, including coverage for medical expenses, dental care, optical services, and more

### **Disability Confident Employer**

We are a Disability Confident employer and offer guaranteed interviews to all disabled applicants who meet the above minimum criteria. To be considered as part of this initiative, please ensure you indicate if you have a disability when applying for the post. If you need any reasonable adjustments to enable you to fully participate in the recruitment process, please contact us at recruitment@haymarket.com.

### **More about Haymarket**

Working here means being part of a commitment to shaping a better future. As a proudly Certified B Corp™, we are part of a global movement of businesses acting as a force for good. Haymarket Impact is focused on making a positive difference globally, guided by the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and intertwined with an unwavering commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion. This commitment to balancing profit with purpose is deeply embedded in our culture, reflected in our values of Integrity, Respect, Creativity, Innovation, and Expertise.

We invest heavily in our people. From professional development and internal training to mentorship and coaching. Our certified Disability Confident status has fostered an environment where all employees feel supported, valued, and can ask for workplace adjustments without fear of judgment.

Our valuable partnerships for good globally mean colleagues are always up for taking on a new charitable challenge, utilise their volunteering day and go out of their way to support their local communities.

We know how important a healthy work-life balance is too. Our flexible hours and hybrid working model means employees are expected to be in the office at least three days a week and can work remotely for the remaining two. This means we thrive together when we collaborate in person, fostering stronger connections and creativity, but still allowing for flexibility outside of those times.

As an equal opportunities employer, we are committed to ensuring all candidates have the same opportunity to succeed, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion, age, or disability. In line with our dedication to fairness and transparency, we are also proud to be a We Show the Salary employer, pledging to always include pay details on our job adverts.

Join us and be part of award-winning teams and a culture that is truly unique - a place to grow, feel inspired, build a brilliant career and make a difference.

title: Senior Commercial Executive
description:
**About the Group**

What’s Possible is the only harmonious group exclusively for marketers at entrepreneurial brands. It invests in, and supports, marketing services businesses in the UK, Europe and US.

At the heart of the group is The Specialist Works, one of the UK’s largest independent media agencies.

The group also includes What’s Possible Creative. Through its investment arm, Make Possible, the group invests in marketing services start-ups – including retail media specialist Vector and US retail media business Connections.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an ambitious Senior Commercial Executive to join our Commercial team.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership, major client relationships, commercial negotiations, contract management, and new business pitches across the Group.

Working closely with the Group Commercial Director, you will take day-to-day ownership of a broad portfolio of commercial and contractual activity, helping to shape commercial outcomes, protect business interests and support sustainable growth across the Group.

Alongside assisting the Group Commercial Director in the management of all commercial and contractual work, you will play an important role in developing and supervising the Commercial Executive, helping to shape the future capability and growth of the Commercial team.

This role would suit someone with experience in commercial management, contract review and negotiation, procurement, business operations, or a similar commercially focused environment who is looking to accelerate their career while gaining exposure to all aspects of a modern media and marketing services business.

**About the Team**

The Commercial Department forms a key part of the Business Partner team within What's Possible Group. We oversee commercial and contractual arrangements involving clients, partners and third parties, supporting businesses across the Group including The Specialist Works, Connections, Ireland, and our Make Possible businesses.

Our role is to ensure commercial agreements are robust, commercially sustainable, operationally deliverable and aligned to the wider strategic objectives of the business.

 **Requirements**

**Commercial and Contractual Management**

* Work with the Group Commercial Director in the preparation, review, negotiation, and administration of a wide range of commercial documentation, including NDAs, DPAs, client agreements, variations, statements of work and partner contracts.
* Review contractual terms, identify risks and opportunities, and provide practical commercial recommendations.
* Manage contract execution processes through DocuSign and maintain accurate commercial records and documentation.
* Produce clear commercial summaries and contract briefings for internal stakeholders.
* Monitor contract renewals, notice periods, key obligations, and commercial commitments.
* Ensure all elements of client commercial arrangements are effectively communicated and understood across the business.

**Commercial Support and Negotiation**

* Take ownership of smaller client commercial projects and negotiations independently.
* Support larger and more complex commercial negotiations alongside the Group Commercial Director.
* Assist in developing innovative, commercially sustainable pricing and remuneration models.
* Support client, procurement, and legal discussions throughout negotiation processes.
* Work closely with Finance regarding payment terms, credit considerations, and commercial reconciliations.
* Identify, manage, and appropriately escalate legal and commercial risks.

**New Business and Growth**

* Support new business pitches, including proposal development, contractual reviews and commercial modelling including helping to build bespoke commercial solutions tailored to client requirements.
* Work with internal teams to cost projects and evaluate commercial viability.
* Contribute to innovative commercial structures that support growth while protecting business profitability.

**Commercial Governance and Reporting**

* Help maintain key commercial databases, trackers, and governance processes.
* Support commercial reporting, profitability analysis, and business insight initiatives.
* Identify emerging commercial risks and escalate appropriately.
* Monitor key contractual milestones, renewal dates, and compliance requirements.
* Help drive continual improvements in commercial processes, controls, and documentation

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Help provide day-to-day supervision, support, and quality control for the Commercial Level 1 Executive.
* Help allocate and prioritise workload across the Commercial team to ensure efficient delivery against business requirements.
* Assist in coaching, training, and developing the Commercial Executive, helping build commercial, contractual, and operational knowledge.
* Review work produced by the Commercial Executive, providing constructive feedback and ensuring high standards of accuracy and quality.
* Support performance management, objective setting, and ongoing development planning.
* Help build a collaborative, high-performing and continually developing Commercial function.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Essential:**

* Practical experience reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements.
* Strong commercial awareness and sound business judgement.
* Experience working within a fast-paced commercial environment.
* Excellent writing, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and excellent document management skills.
* Strong Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills.
* Confidence working with senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

**Desirable:**

* Experience within media, marketing services, advertising, procurement, or professional services.
* Knowledge of GDPR and data protection principles.
* Experience of commercial modelling, pricing, or profitability analysis.
* Familiarity with DocuSign or similar contract management tools.
* Exposure to procurement or legal negotiation processes.

**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Commercially minded and naturally curious.
* Proactive and solutions focused.
* Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail, able to identify inconsistencies, risks and opportunities within complex contracts, commercial arrangements, and business documentation.
* Comfortable reviewing, interpreting, and working with contracts, legal documentation, and formal commercial agreements, with the ability to translate complex language into clear, practical business recommendations.
* Eager to learn and develop.
* Able to balance commercial opportunity with sensible risk management.

 **Benefits**

We provide an exciting, fast paced, people first environment that allows everyone to grow, learn and thrive.

We work a 9-day fortnight, meaning staff have every other Friday off!

We’ve built a benefits package that invests in our employees’ long-term personal and professional growth and wellbeing.

**Our Values**

o **Passion:** You share your excitement about what drives you

o **Inquisitiveness:** Ask “what’s possible?”. Ask “why not?”

o **Caring:** Be a good professional, a good colleague and a good human

o **Knowledge:** Know plenty. Share it. Learn more.

And we live them every day #IamPICK

**Social and Environmental Commitment**

At What’s Possible Group, our mission is to build a group our people are proud of. Proud of what we deliver to clients. Proud of how we treat each other. Proud of our commitment to people, planet and profit.

Having rolled out a What’s Possible University with learning modules & policies, including anti bribery & corruption, DE&I and code of ethics, our people have continuous personal development, and the group is continuously improving.

We are dedicated to embedding social and environmental responsibility into every aspect of our business. You'll contribute to initiatives that promote social equity, diversity, and inclusion within our workplace and in the content, we create, whilst actively supporting and promoting sustainable best practice by, continuously working to minimise waste, (for example, water & cardboard recycling), prioritise eco-friendly suppliers, (for example, renewable energy switch), and promote remote work to reduce carbon emissions.

Your role will include supporting these efforts by helping to implement green office practices, coordinating initiatives that enhance our corporate social responsibility, and ensuring our operations align with our values of sustainability and social responsibility.

Sound good to you? Then get in touch.

*At The What’s Possible Group our culture, our creativity and our passion is powered by people. People just like you. Diversity and difference drive innovation, not only for us but also for our clients and is at the heart of everything that we do.*

title: Education Content Creator - FTC
description:
Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., UAE, Singapore and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

**Do you want to be part of a team that helps solve problems? Are you excited about creating impactful content which helps learners excel? Do you want an opportunity to develop your own skills, and expand your understanding of the future of finance? If so, we want to hear from you!**

**The Role:**

Our customers have varied learning needs, and training requirements to fulfil. Some have compliance or investigations experience in the fiat world, but are new to crypto. Some vice versa.

We understand that one size of training doesn't fit all. We work as a trusted partner, providing solutions to our customer's unique learning needs, whatever the stage of their own crypto journey.

This maternity cover role (a **fixed-term contract of circa 12 months**) sits at the heart of our Education team - you'll take full ownership of our education content and Learning Management System (LMS) operations for the duration of the contract, working closely with our Director of Education Product Development. You'll be bringing your experience, perspective, and ideas to the party!

**What you’ll do:**

You'll be working closely with our Director of Education Product Development, owning the full scope of our education content and LMS operations. While no two days tend to look the same, here's a (non-exhaustive) list, to give you a feel for the range of activities this role may encompass:

* End-to-end learning design and build - building a compelling narrative and nailing the 'so what?' for learners and training managers
* Building bespoke storyboards and learning modules for banking and financial institution customers
* Building e-learning modules using Articulate Rise 360, Canva, and ElevenLabs
* Refreshing, enhancing, and evolving current Elliptic Learn products, ensuring content remains accurate and current
* Creating learning materials ranging from engaging 'knowledge delivery' to immersive, scenario-based practical exercises
* Developing product-based learning to support and certify users of our blockchain analytics tools
* Helping develop role-specific learning journeys across traditional finance, crypto-native, and government segments
* Owning the day-to-day running of the Elliptic Learning Management System (LMS)
* Enrolling and onboarding both internal and external learners onto the LMS, and troubleshooting issues as they arise
* Having direct contact with customers and learners, supporting their overall learning experience
* Working with industry-leading subject matter experts to shape content
* Collaborating on content-marketing projects
* Helping source, test, and deploy new technologies to enhance the learner experience
* Confidently using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ElevenLabs, and similar) to optimise content creation, LMS workflows, and day-to-day tasks
* Finding new ideas and opportunities to enhance the overall Elliptic Learn proposition

**You will be a great fit here if you:**

* Have proven experience in end-to-end learning/instructional design, from storyboarding through to build and deployment
* Have hands-on experience with Articulate 360 (particularly Rise 360)
* Have experience managing an LMS and the associated learner experience (enrolment, troubleshooting, admin)
* Have B2B and B2C learning creation experience
* Have developed and deployed learning across multiple delivery channels
* Enjoy collaborating with a broad range of teams and experts
* Are comfortable communicating directly with customers and learners, including a "front of house" capacity when needed
* Are confident using design and AI-adjacent tools (e.g. Canva, ElevenLabs, or equivalent) to produce polished learning content
* Are comfortable using AI tools to support and speed up day-to-day content and admin tasks
* Are comfortable working autonomously within a small team, wearing multiple hats

**Our ideal candidate is:**

* Focused on the needs of the learner
* Curious, creative and detail-oriented
* Articulate - a strong communicator, orally and in writing
* A bit of a sponge - loves to research, listen, and learn
* Keen to share their ideas on 'what's next, and why we should…'
* Happy to explore new approaches, and be inventive when solving problems
* Not phased by a steep learning curve
* Grasps instructions quickly then can move at pace
* Able to boil complexity down to make it useful and engaging
* Thriving when working as part of a friendly, proactive team
* Collaborative at heart, but very happy flying solo too
* Comfortable being 'front of house' with customers when necessary (with support)
* OK to roll their sleeves up and dive in to whatever needs doing
* Accepting that what they planned to do one day, they may end up not doing, because something more important came up

**Bonus Points if:**

* You’re already familiar with crypto, crypto compliance, and/or blockchain analytics
* You’ve worked with global audiences, and recognise the nuances therein
* You’ve worked with both private sector and government clients, particularly in creating and deploying financial crime and/or product training
* You’re experienced with LearnWorlds LMS, Articulate 360, and Canva
* You’ve got experience of writing/sourcing/researching/curating content

**Job Benefits**
----------------

**> How we work:**

* Hybrid working and the option to work from *almost* anywhere for up to 90 days per year
* £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

**> Learning & Development:**

* $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

**> Vacation/ Leave:**

* Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays
* An extra day for your birthday
* Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

**> Benefits:**

* Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!
* Full access to Spill Mental Health Support
* Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries
* Cycle to Work Scheme

*We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.*

title: Executive Producer
description:
**Dubai, UAE | Full-time, permanent | Full relocation support**

**Run production for our biggest market, from the ground**

The Middle East is Beautiful Destinations' largest market, and it's about to get bigger. We want the person who owns how that work gets made to be in Dubai, in the room with clients and on set when it counts.

You'll lead delivery on our largest client relationship, run our biggest campaigns in the region and work with the best creators in our network. And you'll help shape how a content company built on creators and technology makes work at scale.

**We are Beautiful Destinations**

Beautiful Destinations is a multi-award-winning travel marketing company built where travel, the creator community and technology meet. We started as an Instagram account in 2012. Today we reach a community of 50M+ travelers and work with a network of 500+ creators, filmmakers and storytellers around the world.

We partner with tourism boards, hotel groups and travel brands to make content that works across the whole traveler journey, from the first spark of discovery to the moment someone books. Behind it sits an AI-enabled content platform and more than a decade of our own travel performance data.

Human creativity and authentic storytelling come first. Always. Technology is how we scale them.

See our world:
Instagram
|
TikTok
|
YouTube
|
Beautiful Hotels
|
Website

**The role**

You'll be BD's senior production and delivery leader in the Middle East.

Your portfolio centers on a year-round program of work for our largest client: an always-on creator academy running alongside a slate of flagship campaigns each year. On top of that, you'll own the productions global hotel groups and travel brands bring to Dubai and the wider region.

On a given week you might be checking in with the Lead Producer running the academy, standing beside a senior client on a campaign shoot, scoping a campaign that landed yesterday and shaping a proposal for one that hasn't been sold yet. Every project starts with you once the sale is done. You set the timing plan, the scope, the budget and the approach, then bring in the right producer and let them run.

Once a plan and budget are locked, the production is yours. You make the calls on spend, timing and contracts, and you're the person people turn to when a live production needs experience and a calm head.

And you'll think past the current job. Why sign location managers quarter by quarter when an annual deal would work harder? Where should we use freelance producers, and where do we need permanent ones? How do we move footage around the world? You'll bring those answers, and you'll use your own clients as the test bed.

The success of every BD production is scored on simple questions. Would the client recommend us? Did we make cinematic content that stops people in their tracks, or social content that moves them to act? Did we use process, technology or AI to get ahead of the competition? Your job is to keep those scores rising across everything you touch.

**What you'll do**

* Own delivery of our Middle East program of work, keeping the always-on academy running without a hitch and overseeing 2 to 3 campaigns at a time.
* Turn every newly sold project into a plan: brief, timing, scope, budget and production approach, before handing it to the right producer.
* Lead, coach and back up the Lead Producers and producers running day-to-day delivery, stepping in when a production needs you and stepping back when it doesn't.
* Be the trusted delivery partner for senior clients, on calls, in leadership meetings and on shoot days.
* Think across the whole program. Move budget where it does most good, build longer-term supplier deals, and give us a clear view on how the team should be shaped.
* Deliver great work at strong margins, with a clear read on budgets, actuals and which decisions create or erode value.
* Work with Creative and Creators to pick the right creators for each brief, and hold a point of view on the work itself.
* Run feasibility, permitting, insurance and compliance across the region, knowing where the risks are before anyone gets on a plane.
* Lead your own initiatives to move BD forward, from AI prompt packs that keep 30 editors on-brand to automating release forms and rethinking how footage is stored and shared.

**What you'll bring**

We care more about the experience in your years than the years of experience. Around 10 years in production is a good guide, but if you've tackled more in 8 years than most do in 15, we want to hear from you. If you're a senior producer ready to step up to EP, this could be that move.

* You know the craft. You've come up through production and know the best way to make great work on budget.
* You're operationally sharp. You can write an estimate, a proposal and a timing plan that actually holds, and push a project through a business without it stalling.
* You're confident with clients. You present solutions clearly, understand what the client is worried about and set up feedback so it helps the work.
* You've owned a program of work, beyond single productions, and thought about it commercially: where money sits, where it should move and what the next year needs.
* You've led and developed other producers and made them better.
* You have a view on the work. You won't write the script, but you'll know which creator fits the concept and when something on screen doesn't feel right.
* You've made cinematic hero films and social-first, always-on content, and you understand how they work together from discovery through to booking.
* You're genuinely excited about AI and technology in production, and you have examples of using it to make work faster, better or cheaper.
* You've worked in production companies, creator-led studios or social-first agencies, where pace and flexibility matter as much as rigor.

Experience shooting in the GCC is a real advantage. Experience in Saudi Arabia, one of the region's more complex markets, even more so.

**Is this you?**

You'll love this role if you want ownership, move fast and get a kick out of fixing the way work gets made as well as making it.

It probably won't suit you if you'd rather stay a line producer focused on the next shoot, if you want tightly drawn boundaries around your job, or if you're sceptical about what AI can do for production.

* A creative and consultative approach, with an interest in thinking outside of the box
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Proven project management skills and creative problem-solving abilities
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex projects simultaneously

title: Senior Motion & Graphic Designer
description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.  
  
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

### **What you will do:**

* Translate strategy into visuals: partner closely with our Creative Strategist to take research, hooks, and loose creative briefs and turn them into concrete visual concepts, storyboards, and finished assets
* Produce both statics and video: design and build static ad creative and edit/produce short-form video and motion content for paid social at a consistently high craft level
* Interpret brand guidance at any altitude: work from anything ranging from a thin one-pager to a comprehensive brand system, and reliably produce creative that's unmistakably on-brand either way
* Navigate regulated-industry review cycles: produce creative that anticipates compliance and legal scrutiny, minimizing revision rounds and rejection risk without watering down creative quality
* Push brands into new creative territory: identify opportunities to evolve a brand's creative expression to unlock scale and new-market growth, while staying inside brand-safety guardrails
* Select and edit raw footage/imagery: review raw photography and video footage from shoots and select, crop, cut, and edit the strongest material into finished assets — no on-set creative direction required
* Own asset quality and turnaround: deliver polished, client-ready work with minimal internal revision cycles so assets aren't burning days internally before they even reach the client
* Maintain visual consistency at scale: keep creative consistent and on-brand across a high volume of ad variations, formats, and platform

### **What we are looking for:**

**Core Experience**  

* 5+ years in a hands-on creative production role — Art Director, Senior Designer, Creative Producer, or similar —with dedicated performance/paid social experience
* A portfolio that shows range across both static design and video/motion editing, ideally for paid social specifically
* Experience working within brand guidelines of varying depth and translating them into new creative applications
* Experience in regulated or highly regulated industries (healthcare, finance, insurance, legal, or similar) is a strong plus, given our client base
* Experience working in matrixed organizations with multiple stakeholders and layered approval processes

  
**Craft & Technical Skills**  

* Expert-level proficiency in Figma (or similar) for static design and layout
* Strong proficiency in After Effects (or similar) for motion graphics and video editing

Creative & Strategic Judgment

* Understands performance/paid-social fundamentals (hooks, pacing, hierarchy, CTAs) well enough to make smart creative calls independently, without needing to run the strategy
* Can take a loose brief or visual direction and fill in the gaps with sound creative judgment
* High attention to detail — typos, brand misapplications, and spec errors don't make it to client review
* Comfortable giving and receiving fast, iterative feedback in a deadline-driven environment

  
**Working Style**  

* Thrives on speed without sacrificing polish — this role owns production timelines that need to move fast to offset long approval cycles
* Collaborative by nature; sees the Creative Strategist as a partner, not a hand-off point
* Self-sufficient in production; doesn't need heavy oversight to get from brief to finished asset

### **What success looks like:**

* Assets consistently reach client/compliance review in 1–2 internal revision rounds or fewer
* Creative reliably passes compliance and legal review with minimal rework
* Output balances brand safety with creative freshness — clients see growth and new territory, not just "more of the same"
* The Strategist and Senior Performance Creative function as a true two-person creative engine, each covering what the other doesn't

### **What This Role Is Not:**

* Not a photo/video shoot creative director — you won't be expected to run or direct live shoots, just to select and edit from what's captured
* Not a pure strategist — research, testing frameworks, and reporting live with the Creative Strategist, not this role

title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.

Key Accountabilities

**Leadership and Operations:**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
* Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
* Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
* Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.

**Solution Engineering:**

* Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
* Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
* Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
* Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
* Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
* Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.

**Customer Support Operations:**

* Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
* Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
* Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
* Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
* Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
* Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
* Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.

Who You Are

**Skills/Knowledge:**

* Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
* Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
* Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
* Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
* Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
* Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.

**Requirements:**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
* 12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
* Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team

**Preferred Skills:**

* SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
* Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
* Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
* Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.  
  
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of **$195,000 to $220,000** and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.

Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!

**At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:**

* All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
* We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
* We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
* Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

title: Site Merchandising & Operations Manager
description:

title: Digital Marketing & Creative Specialist
description:
**Digital Marketing & Creative Specialist**

**Position Overview**

The Boyd Companies, Inc. is a 100% employee-owned company. We are looking for a creative, technically curious **Digital Marketing & Creative Specialist** to join our marketing team.

This role is ideal for someone who works remotely and gets things done. This person has a strong eye for design, understands what makes creative content visually effective, and enjoys turning ideas into engaging digital content. You will help create marketing materials for websites, social media, digital advertising, email campaigns, video, and other digital platforms.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use design software. We want someone who understands **why a design works**—from layout and visual hierarchy to typography, color psychology, composition, spacing, and branding.

You should also be comfortable learning new technology. Digital marketing and creative production are changing quickly, and we are looking for someone who is excited to explore new software, platforms, and AI tools that can make our marketing more creative, efficient, and effective.

A college degree is **not required**. We care more about your creativity, portfolio, technical ability, willingness to learn, and ability to produce great work.

**What You'll Do**

You will work closely with the Marketing Director to develop creative content and execute digital marketing initiatives across multiple brands, communities, campaigns, and platforms.

Responsibilities may include:

* Design digital marketing materials for social media, websites, digital ads, email campaigns, landing pages, presentations, signage, and other marketing channels.
* Create visually engaging social media graphics, short-form videos, reels, stories, advertisements, and web content.
* Edit and produce video content for websites, YouTube, social media, digital advertising, and other platforms.
* Use AI image and video generation tools to create, enhance, modify, and experiment with marketing creative.
* Write effective prompts and refine AI-generated images, video, and creative concepts until they meet brand and quality standards.
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of websites and landing pages.
* Resize, adapt, and optimize creative assets for different advertising platforms, devices, screen sizes, and placements.
* Help develop creative concepts for digital advertising campaigns.
* Maintain brand consistency across multiple digital channels and campaigns.
* Select appropriate fonts, colors, imagery, layouts, and visual styles based on the audience, brand, and campaign objective.
* Apply design principles such as balance, contrast, hierarchy, alignment, repetition, proportion, and whitespace.
* Understand and apply color theory and the psychology of color when developing marketing materials.
* Understand how typography and font selection can influence brand perception, readability, emotion, and user experience.
* Review creative work critically and identify opportunities to improve layout, readability, visual hierarchy, messaging, and overall effectiveness.
* Help organize and maintain digital creative assets, templates, photography, video, logos, brand files, and marketing resources.
* Stay current with design trends, social media trends, digital advertising formats, creative technology, and AI tools.
* Test new creative approaches and help identify what types of content generate the strongest engagement and marketing results.
* Collaborate with other members of the marketing, sales, operations, and leadership teams as needed.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate has a combination of **creativity, design judgment, curiosity, and technical confidence**.

You should have:

* A strong eye for good design and the ability to recognize when something visually works—and when it does not.
* A working understanding of fundamental design principles.
* Knowledge of color theory and an understanding of how color can influence emotion, attention, perception, and behavior.
* An understanding of typography, font pairing, readability, and how different font styles influence brand perception.
* Strong visual composition and layout skills.
* An understanding of branding and the importance of maintaining a consistent visual identity.
* Experience creating content for social media and digital platforms.
* Experience using creative or design software.
* Basic video editing skills or a strong desire to learn video production.
* Comfort working with AI-powered creative tools for image generation, video generation, editing, brainstorming, and content production.
* The ability to learn new software independently and quickly.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good organizational and time management skills.
* The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines is important.
* The ability to accept creative feedback and improve work based on direction.
* The confidence to bring new ideas to the table is important.

**Software & Technology**

You do not need to know every platform we use on your first day.

You **do** need to be comfortable learning new tools.

Experience with any of the following is helpful:

* Adobe Creative Cloud
* Photoshop
* Illustrator
* InDesign
* Premiere Pro
* After Effects
* Canva
* WordPress or other website platforms
* Social media management platforms
* Email marketing platforms
* Google Workspace
* Microsoft Office
* Digital advertising platforms
* AI image-generation tools
* AI video-generation tools
* AI writing and marketing tools
* Photo and video editing software

**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**Note: This is a remote role based in Pacific Time, with a preference for candidates located in San Francisco.**

**About The Role**
------------------

Playground and Console are where developers meet Deepgram for the first time. Our redesigns are shipping into development now, and both surfaces have steady, real UI work ahead of them.

We're looking for a Product Designer to own that execution. You'll work alongside our senior designers on feature-level work, take assigned pieces end to end once the direction is set, and float to whichever surface needs design hours that week. The work is well-defined and it matters: it is the first impression of the product for most of the people who use it.

This role is deliberately flexible. You'll build fluency in our design system, our developer audience, and our product faster than you would sitting on one surface for a year, and you'll be the reason senior designers get to stay on the problems only they can solve.

You'll report directly to the Director of Product Design.

**Your first chapter**: feature-level UI across Playground and Console, running on Cosmos, our design system.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design and refine UI across the Playground and Console experiences, working from a defined problem and a general solution direction
* Support senior designers on feature work, taking assigned pieces end to end with minimal guidance once the approach is set
* Pick up design work wherever capacity is needed, across product surfaces
* Apply Cosmos consistently, and exercise judgment on the edge cases the system does not answer yet
* Document the why alongside the what, so your decisions are legible to the team and to engineering
* Give regular updates, present your rationale in critique, and give your peers feedback worth having
* Use our AI and design tooling in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team

--------------------------------

* Take pride in execution, and care whether the spacing is right
* Want range early, across multiple surfaces and problem types, rather than one narrow lane
* Like designing for developers, and find technical products more interesting than intimidating
* Want to learn from senior designers by working next to them on real work
* Are excited to move at the pace of AI and figure out where these tools genuinely help

We care more about expertise and leadership than years of experience.

* Strong UI craft, with a portfolio that shows clear visual and interaction judgment
* Experience taking feature-level work end to end, from direction through production handoff
* Fluency working inside a design system, and the judgment to know when a pattern does not fit

* Experience contributing to a design system rather than only consuming one

title: Senior Product Development & Brand Manager
description:
**Build the trading cards collectors will chase next.**  
  
Pulse Trading Cards is a rapidly growing trading-card manufacturer developing sports and licensed collectible products for hobby shops, major retailers, and collectors directly.  
Our portfolio includes brands such as Big League Chew, Foundry, Drift, and Aura, with an expanding pipeline of sports, entertainment, and consumer-brand collaborations. We’re looking for a Senior Product Development & Brand Manager to own assigned brands and product lines, create distinctive releases, and build the detailed configurations that turn great concepts into finished products.  
This is a hands-on role combining creative product development, deep hobby knowledge, and strong analytical skills. You should be equally comfortable developing an original insert concept, evaluating an autograph checklist, and building an Excel model that reconciles every card, pack, box, and case.  
You’ll work directly with our CEO and collaborate with Creative, Athlete Partnerships, Project Management, Operations, Sales, and Marketing.  
  
**What you’ll own**  
  
**Brand strategy and release planning**

  

* Own the product direction and release roadmap for assigned brands, sports, or licensed properties.
* Define each brand’s audience, positioning, signature features, and place within the Pulse portfolio.
* Develop original product concepts, inserts, parallels, autograph programs, and chase cards.
* Plan how products evolve across releases while preserving the features collectors recognize and value.
* Recommend release timing, formats, production quantities, and channel-specific configurations using collector demand, sales input, and business priorities.

**Set builds and product configurations**

  

* Personally build and maintain detailed checklists, configuration models, and product-development workbooks.
* Define base sets, inserts, parallels, autograph content, numbering, and pack, box, and case structures.
* Calculate card quantities, autograph requirements, insertion rates, and allocation needs across all product formats.
* Reconcile checklist quantities, serial-numbered content, production totals, and stated product guarantees.
* Work with Athlete Partnerships and Autograph Operations to build products around confirmed rights, available inventory, and realistic signing timelines.
* Identify shortages, conflicting allocations, and configuration issues early, and recommend practical solutions.
* Maintain clear, accurate documentation and version control as products move toward production.

**Product economics and commercial performance**

  

* Develop product budgets with Operations and Finance, accounting for autographs, manufacturing, packaging, royalties, freight, and other relevant costs.
* Evaluate how changes to print runs, content, materials, and configurations affect margin and the collector experience.
* Partner with Sales to align product formats and quantities with demand across hobby, retail, and direct-to-consumer channels.
* Review release performance, sell-through, collector feedback, and product issues to improve future launches.

**Creative development and execution**

  

* Write complete product briefs covering the concept, checklist structure, insert themes, photography needs, copy, and design requirements.
* Partner with the Creative Director and design team to translate product ideas into compelling cards and packaging.
* Review designs for alignment with the product concept, content accuracy, and configuration requirements.
* Coordinate with Project Management and licensing stakeholders to keep assets, approvals, and decisions moving.
* Partner with Operations to resolve production constraints while protecting the product’s defining features.
* Provide accurate product details, selling points, checklist information, and configuration summaries for launch materials.

**Faster, more reliable product development**

  

* Develop reusable templates and standards that reduce repetitive work and improve build accuracy.
* Help connect product data, autograph inventory, creative assets, and production requirements.
* Use advanced Excel capabilities, automation, and appropriate AI tools to improve efficiency while maintaining rigorous validation.
* Manage multiple releases simultaneously, surface risks early, and follow decisions through to completion.

**What you bring**

  

* Typically 5+ years of relevant product-development or brand-management experience, including direct responsibility for trading-card or closely related collectible releases.
* Demonstrated ability to take physical products from concept through detailed development and launch.
* Deep understanding of trading cards, collector behavior, checklists, parallels, autographs, scarcity, and hobby versus retail configurations.
* Advanced Excel skills, including lookups, SUMIFS, pivot tables, data validation, and structured models with reliable error checks.
* Strong mathematical reasoning and comfort working with quantities, probabilities, allocation models, budgets, and gross margins.
* The ability to create distinctive product concepts and translate them into precise, executable specifications.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and written communication.
* A record of managing competing deadlines, making informed decisions, and owning outcomes.
* The ability to work independently in a remote environment and collaborate consistently with a team operating primarily on Eastern Time.

**Experience that stands out**

  

* Direct product-development experience at a trading-card manufacturer.
* Ownership of autograph-driven sports products or licensed entertainment collectibles.
