title: Senior Account Manager (Creator Marketing)
description:
As a Senior Account Manager at Trevant, you are the point person for your accounts, the person who represents Trevant to the client every single day. The creator space moves fast, and you're the kind of person who's already tracking where it's headed. Reporting to the Director of Influencer Strategy & Operations, you will own the client relationship, turn strategic ideas into campaigns that deliver results, and push our thinking forward rather than just executing what's already been decided. You'll be goaled on client satisfaction, retention, account growth and health - not just flawless execution. This role is for someone who wants to test new approaches, defend the strategy when it matters, and take full ownership of outcomes that keep our clients coming back again and again.

This role is perfect for someone focused on both execution and ownership, push the envelope on new ideas, stay ahead of a space that never stops changing, and drive alignment across a growing team.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the client's day-to-day point of contact and main “go-to,” leading client discussions with clarity and confidence, backed by a clear point of view and best practices.
* Take strategic ideas from concept to execution, championing new approaches with the team and client, and owning the follow-through that turns a great idea into a live campaign.
* Own campaign plans end-to-end, tying every recommendation back to client objectives and KPIs; develop strategic rationales and POVs, push back on creative recommendations when they don't serve the strategy, and pitch new approaches worth testing when you see an opportunity.
* Stay closely tuned to creator and platform trends as they happen, translating what you're seeing into innovative ideas and differentiators that keep us a step at the forefront of the industry.
* Own the communication channels for your accounts, leading client check-ins, updates, follow-up summaries, QBRs, and internal syncs so both sides always know where things stand.
* Own recurring performance reporting against client KPIs, translating results into a clear narrative on what's working and what's next, not just a summary of what happened.
* Provide direction on organizing and streamlining project workflows, schedules, briefs, and management sheets, and step in to fix gaps or inefficiencies as they surface.
* Bring a solution-driven mindset to the account, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen the client relationship, increase account stickiness, and improve internal workflows and processes.
* Leverage and operationalize AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow, from research and reporting to campaign development, and look for ways to apply them more broadly to drive efficiency across workflows and elevate our service level to clients.
* Own hard-cost creator trackers and budget control reports to ensure financial accuracy and internal margin goals are met, follow up with finance, and lead discussions around creator compensation negotiation and campaign budgets.
* Treat retention as a daily discipline, proactively identifying risk signals and building the kind of trust and results that make renewal a formality.
* Drive alignment across the creator team, ensuring Account Coordinators and Sr. Account Coordinators are set up to execute against the account strategy with clarity and confidence.
* Partner closely with the paid amplification team to build a cohesive, cross-functional working relationship, ensuring you can speak confidently to the full program holistically, not just the organic workstream.
* Manage multiple clients and competing deadlines, proactively communicating risks and keeping stakeholders ahead of any changes.
* Ensure the team is aligned on priorities and equipped to execute confidently; present wrap reports and updates internally and externally with clarity and professionalism.

  
**Requirements**  

* 3 to 6+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator operations or a related agency role.
* Hands-on familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube from a creator partnership or brand marketing perspective. Experience using Sprout Social or a comparable platform is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to write persuasive briefs, POVs, and reports, and present confidently to clients.
* Track record of managing multiple accounts or projects simultaneously with minimal oversight, including team mentorship or delegation experience.
* Able to tie campaign performance back to client business objectives; comfortable owning budget trackers and financial reconciliation.
* Understands full funnel performance metrics; comfortable discussing conversion, ROAS, and revenue impact, and connecting creator activity to real business outcomes. Has experience translating a creator strategy into a performance engine.
* Highly organized with a track record of managing multiple workstreams simultaneously. You stay on top of details, flag blockers early, and follow through without being chased.
* A low-ego, team-first mindset. You are energized by collaboration, comfortable asking questions, and confident in taking ownership of your work.
* Analytical experience in pulling data and spotting patterns. Expertise with Excel or Google Sheets is expected; experience with BI reporting tools like DOMO is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Genuinely obsessed with the creator space, constantly tracking trends and platform shifts with a real desire to keep learning. Adaptable by nature, comfortable with a space that never sits still, and ready to evolve with it.

**Who We Are**

Trevant is a creator marketing agency built for brands that need more than a campaign. They need a system that justifies the investment.

We came up in performance media. We ran hundreds of millions in paid social spend before most agencies knew what attribution meant. When the creator economy took off, we didn't chase it. We applied the same operational rigor — vetting, attribution, brand safety, efficiency — to a channel that needed it.

The result is creator marketing that performs like your best paid channel. Creative ambition that earns attention. Infrastructure that makes that attention compound into outcomes. Every campaign, fully accountable.

Trevant is a subsidiary of Fluent, a commerce media solutions provider connecting top-tier brands with highly engaged consumers.

 **Benefits**

At Trevant, we celebrate successes, value teamwork, and foster a vibrant, inclusive culture. In addition to offering the opportunity to work with a rapidly growing creator performance marketing agency, we provide:

* Competitive compensation packages
* Career advancement and professional development opportunities
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plan with employer matching
* Opportunities to participate in volunteer and philanthropic activities
* Fun and educational team events, including catered lunches, team outings, and wellness initiatives

**Salary Range**

$85,000-$115,000 base salary plus a competitive incentive compensation plan tied to performance. Actual base salary will depend on factors such as experience, skill set, and location.

At Trevant, we are committed to building and fostering an environment where our employees feel included, valued, and heard. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on age, color, ability, national origin, race, religion, sex, or sexual orientation. Not only are these provisions protected by law, embracing differences is what makes Trevant so great. We pride ourselves on our inclusive and accessible workplace. If you need any accommodations during the interview process to make it work for you, let us know.

title: Director of Marketing
description:
Description:

**About Balavant**

Balavant Insurance Group is a fast-growing insurance holding company and MGA operator platform, backed by private equity firm SkyKnight Capital. We currently operate four portfolio companies, each with its own brand, broker relationships, and go-to-market motion, and we are actively acquiring and launching new programs with the expectation to grow to 15 portfolio companies over the next few years.

**The Opportunity**

This is a rare seat: one marketing leader operating across an entire platform rather than a single brand. You will own strategy, vendor management, and hands-on execution for a portfolio that spans specialty commercial insurance. No two weeks look the same.

We've deliberately built this role to be high-leverage rather than high-headcount. You'll have a vendor bench for specialist execution (SEO, paid media buying, HubSpot administration) so your time goes to the work only you can do: strategy, prioritization, vendor management, and creative. AI-assisted production is core to how this function runs.

Requirements:

**What You'll Do**

* Set program-level marketing strategy across four (and growing) portfolio companies, each with distinct programs, audiences, channels, and competitive dynamics.
* Prioritize demand for marketing services across the platform and defend those calls to portfolio company leadership
* Partner directly with portfolio company CEOs and platform leadership, representing marketing in executive-level conversations
* Direct and execute brand and creative production, setting standards and using AI tooling to accelerate output
* Build brand identity and credibility for new portfolio companies (logo, brand voice, image, visual identity)
* Manage a vendor bench for specialist execution (creative, paid media, content, HubSpot implementation), holding partners accountable for cost and quality
* Select and setup MarTech stack
* Own hands-on execution of demand generation programs in HubSpot: campaign creation, retargeting, lead scoring, segmentation, MQL reporting
* Establish self-serve tools and branded templates so portfolio company sales teams can handle low-complexity marketing needs independently
* Own budget, allocation, and forecasting for the marketing function

**What We're Looking For**

* 8-12 years in B2B demand generation or marketing BizOps experience
* Experience selling through an intermediated or broker-based channel
* Exceptionally strong in prioritization, creative problem solving, and execution
* A track record spanning strategy, creative and content production, and marketing operations, not just one lane.
* Comfortable declining requests and managing executive expectations with a firm, respected hand.
* Willing to ship AI-assisted creative that meets a high bar without chasing perfection on every asset.
* Curious about next-generation, AI-forward marketing workflows rather than defaulting to agency production.

**Why This Role**

You'll get the breadth of an agency, the culture of a startup, and the backing of a capitalized platform that is actively expanding. As Balavant adds portfolio companies, this role grows with it, in scope, visibility, and impact, not in layers of process. If you want one job that never gets boring and a direct line to see your work shape a growing platform, this is it.

title: Chief Desing Officer
description:

**UN DÍA EN EL ROL**

* Dar seguimiento a los proyectos de new business y a las cuentas activas que requieran su intervención.
* Monitorear la calidad de los entregables de diseño audiovisual de las cuentas en operación.
* Sostener un touch point semanal con la Head de Diseño y su equipo para dar seguimiento y

feedback.

* Coordinarse con Estrategia, Content e Innovación desde las etapas tempranas del brief en proyectos clave.
* Tomar decisiones de diseño siempre que se cumplan los deadlines, y escalar cuando un deadline con cliente se vea afectado.
* Reportar a la Dirección General el estado de las cuentas, la operación y el desarrollo del equipo creativo.

**EXPERIENCIA Y SKILLS**

* 10+ años de experiencia en diseño con enfoque digital, en agencias creativas, de publicidad o de marketing.
* Trayectoria comprobada hasta posiciones de liderazgo creativo (Director/a de Arte Senior o equivalente).
* Experiencia liderando proyectos de alto impacto, new business y equipos creativos, manteniendo altos estándares de calidad.
* Dominio de Adobe Creative Suite, Figma y After Effects, y uso cotidiano de herramientas de IA aplicadas al diseño.
* Liderazgo y mentoría: desarrolla talento, eleva el nivel del equipo y promueve una cultura de colaboración, aprendizaje y mejora continua.
* Perfil que combina visión estratégica con capacidad de ejecución, criterio creativo y orientación a resultados.

**PERFIL IDEAL**

* Referente en tendencias de diseño y entusiasta de la IA.
* Conocimiento profundo de marketing digital y redes sociales.

**EQUIPO Y REPORTE**

* Reporta a la Dirección General de la agencia.
* Trabaja de la mano con la Head de Diseño, quien tiene a cargo un equipo de 5 diseñadores.
* Interactúa con las áreas de Innovación, Estrategia, Cuentas y Content.

**CONDICIONES**

* Modalidad híbrida (3 oficina + 2 HO)
* Salario competitivo + beneficios coorporativos.

Sueldo: $50,000.00 - $60,000.00 al mes

Lugar de trabajo: remoto híbrido en Ciudad de México, CDMX

* Coordinates and executes Hotel and F&B printed materials.

* Controls quantity and inventory of all Hotel marketing collateral and verifies copies are filed in a comprehensive manner.

* Assists in the production of all property, F&B display, and temporary signage in hotel public areas.

* Promotes collection of competitors collateral and publicity on a monthly basis.

* Manages the execution of F&B direct marketing activities.

* Verifies all collateral is as per brand standard guidelines and in compliance with Brand Standard Audit (BSA).

* Assists and manages the development, co-ordination and execution of all communications activities with a strong emphasis on property F&B promotions and campaigns.

* Helps with the publication of hotel’s newsletter(s).

* Supports communications duties and functions as deemed necessary.

* Assists in the liaison and execution of joint F&B promotions.

* Works with eCommerce to verify the Hotel’s website and related websites are updated on a regular basis.

* Partners with Director of Marketing to create marketing plan aligned to hotel sales and revenue strategy.

* Provides training and marketing leadership and act as a marketing subject matter expert for GMs, Sales Leaders and Managers, and Revenue leaders.

title: Interior Designer
description:
Female Interior Designer wanted: Dubai | Salary + Apartment

title: Fractional Media Director (Part-Time)
description:
**ABOUT PHASE 3 MARKETING & COMMUNICATIONS:**  
  
Phase 3 Marketing and Communications is an integrated marketing services company providing solutions from ideation to execution. Our mission is to simplify life for marketers by delivering the most-needed marketing services in-house, under one roof.  
  
A certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Corporate Plus® member, Phase 3 has offices in Atlanta, Dallas, Nashville, and the New York City metropolitan area. Since its founding in 2001, Phase 3 has been recognized as a top company by *Inc. 5000,* *Printing Impressions,* *Atlanta Business Chronicle, and Nashville Business Journal*.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
  
The Fractional Media Director serves as the senior strategic leader for Phase 3’s media practice, providing integrated media strategy, senior client counsel, team leadership and guidance on emerging channels and opportunities.  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for an experienced agency media professional who can move comfortably between high-level strategy, client conversations, team development and campaign oversight. The Media Director will lead strategy across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C clients while helping the internal media team strengthen its strategic capabilities and deliver increasingly proactive recommendations.  
  
The ideal candidate brings broad experience across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out-of-home and other media channels along with proficiency in website tracking across Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Experience with consumer brands and retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing is highly desirable.  
  
**FRACTIONAL ENGAGEMENT STRUCTURE:**  
  
This is an ongoing fractional leadership engagement requiring approximately **4-5 hours per** **week/ 20 hours per month.** The Fractional Media Director will function as an integrated member of the Phase 3 team and senior leader of the media practice.  
  
The role offers flexibility in how hours are structured but requires consistent weekly availability for the media team, key client meetings, strategic planning sessions and new business opportunities, with 2-3 internal team meetings scheduled per week (not exceeding 2 hours total), monthly reporting calls with clients and the remaining time being used on-call, as needed.  
  
Work will be primarily remote with in-person participation at Phase 3’s Atlanta office and client meetings when valuable.  
  
The initial engagement is expected to be six months, with the opportunity to extend or expand the engagement based on business needs and growth of the media practice.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

**Media Strategy & Client Leadership**

  

* Provide senior strategic oversight across paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio, out-of-home, metasearch, retail media and emerging channels.
* Serve as Phase 3’s senior media advisor for key client relationships.
* Lead integrated media strategies connecting client business objectives, audiences, channels, investment and measurement.
* Guide annual, quarterly and campaign-specific media planning for key accounts.
* Evaluate channel mix, audience strategy, investment levels, KPIs and testing opportunities.
* Translate campaign performance and marketplace changes into actionable strategic recommendations.
* Lead or participate in strategic planning sessions, major presentations, quarterly business reviews and other senior-level client conversations.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, test new approaches and expand client media programs.

  

**Team Leadership & Development**

  

* Provide strategic leadership, coaching and mentorship to Phase 3’s internal media team.
* Develop team capabilities in integrated media strategy, planning, optimization, analytics and client communication.
* Establish clear roles and accountability across internal team members and specialized external media resources.
* Conduct regular account and strategy reviews and help team members move beyond performance reporting to meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend training, tools or specialist support.
* Support agency leadership in assessing media capacity, staffing needs and longer-term organizational structure.
  

**Media Innovation & Performance**

  

* Stay current on changes in media technology, advertising platforms, consumer behavior, privacy, measurement and AI-enabled media buying.
* Help expand Phase 3’s capabilities in retail media, including Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Kroger Precision Marketing and other relevant networks.
* Evaluate emerging platforms and develop disciplined approaches to testing new channels.
* Provide senior oversight of campaign performance, optimization, budget pacing and investment strategy.
* Ensure media reporting clearly communicates what happened, why it happened and what actions should be taken.
* Establish consistent standards for media planning, QA, optimization, reporting and measurement.

  

**Growth & New Business**

  

* Partner with agency leadership, account teams and Sales to identify organic growth opportunities within existing client relationships.
* Participate in new-business discovery, media strategy development, pitches and presentations.
* Help develop media scopes, staffing approaches, management fees and investment recommendations.
* Strengthen Phase 3’s media capabilities, case studies and strategic points of view.
* Support the long-term growth and evolution of the media practice.
  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

**Required**

  

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive media experience, with significant experience in an advertising, media, digital or integrated agency environment.
* Recent practical, hands-on experience in advertising platforms including Google, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Previous experience in a Media Director, Group Media Director, VP of Media, Head of Media or comparable senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience developing integrated media strategies across multiple channels and platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of paid social, paid search, programmatic, display, CTV, digital audio and out-of-home.
* Strong understanding of audience strategy, media planning, measurement, attribution and performance analytics.
* Experience managing significant media investments and providing senior-level client counsel.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing media professionals.
* Experience directing specialized internal and external media resources.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and client communication skills.
* Strong commercial judgment and understanding of agency scope, staffing, client service and account profitability.
* Ability to provide consistent leadership, availability and accountability within a fractional structure.

  

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with CPG and consumer brands.
* Experience with retail media networks such as Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect and Kroger Precision Marketing.
* Experience with hospitality, travel or multi-location businesses.
* Experience with B2B media strategy and account-based marketing.
* Experience helping build or expand an agency media practice.
* Experience supporting agency new business and organic account growth.

  

**Successful Profile:**

  

* A senior strategist who sees the client’s broader business challenge rather than media as a collection of individual platforms.
* A confident client leader who can establish credibility with senior marketing executives.
* A proactive thinker who brings forward recommendations and opportunities before being asked.
* A collaborative leader who stays close enough to campaign execution to guide decisions, troubleshoot challenges and strengthen outcomes.
* A strong coach who develops team members rather than simply taking over their work.
* Broad media expertise combined with the judgment to know when specialized expertise is needed.
* Strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations.
* Commercially minded, collaborative and comfortable operating within a lean team.
* Committed to developing people while helping build a more sophisticated, proactive and scalable media practice.

Oversees requirements analysis and manages reviews of wireframes, prototypes, and design systems. Allocates resources for user research, usability testing, and accessibility audits. Reviews design documentation, user feedback, and compliance reports. Manages budgets for design tools, user testing platforms, and training. Mentors designers in user-centered design practices and iterative improvement, and represents the team in technical reviews, stakeholder meetings, and client presentations. Position Details:

McAfee is seeking a **Director of Product Design** to lead our product design and systems team, raise the bar for design quality, and help the organization deliver better product experiences with greater speed, consistency, and business impact.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and executive stakeholders to shape UX strategy, strengthen design operations, and integrate design earlier into planning and delivery. * **Build operational excellence** through stronger planning, prioritization, design reviews, decision-making, documentation, and cross-functional alignment.

* **Lead and influence cross-functionally** with Product, Engineering, Research, Marketing, Data, and executive stakeholders to align strategy, scope, trade-offs, and delivery plans.

* **Grow talent and design culture** by coaching managers and senior ICs, applying the levels and skills framework, and building a culture of ownership, feedback, high craft, and measurable outcomes.

* Proven ability to set strategy, translate ambiguity into clear priorities, and connect design work to customer and business outcomes.

* Strong experience with design systems, reusable patterns, cross-platform design, and design-to-engineering handoff.

* Practical fluency with AI-enabled product design workflows and strong judgment about where AI can improve speed, quality, system adoption, and implementation readiness versus where human craft must lead.

* Track record of raising design quality, delivery discipline, operational effectiveness, and implementation fidelity across teams.

* Experience using research, data, experimentation, and customer insight to guide product direction and validate decisions.

* Strong executive communication, storytelling, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence.

* Experience mentoring and developing design managers, senior designers, and future design leaders against clear level expectations.

* Commitment to inclusive design, accessibility, privacy, trust, and responsible AI practices.

Success Looks Like

* Teams deliver higher-quality work with clearer expectations, stronger rituals, and better handoff.

* AI-enabled product design workflows improve concept exploration, prototyping, design system usage, critique, QA, and engineering handoff quality.

* The design system reduces inconsistency, rework, and implementation ambiguity.

* Design is engaged earlier in planning and contributes more directly to product strategy and business outcomes.

* Managers and designers understand what great looks like at their level and have clearer paths for growth.

title: Campaign and Media Director
description:
Overview:

Help tell the story of America's longest war**.** As Campaign and Media Director, you'll shape how the nation hears the Afghanistan War Commission's findings on two decades of U.S. decisions in Afghanistan, leading a high-profile campaign from launch through the release of the Commission's final report to Congress.

The Campaign and Media Director leads the full range of strategic communications, public engagement, digital, content, event, media monitoring, and data visualization support for the Afghanistan War Commission. The Director helps the Commission reach the media, key stakeholders, and the public, with emphasis on the rollout of the Commission's final report to Congress. The Director works collaboratively with Commission staff to ensure all work products meet the needs of the Commission, Commissioners, and staff.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Top Workplace by the Washington Post, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

**Work Schedule and Location:**

**Remote**: This part-time remote position will work Monday through Friday, with approximately 20 hours a week, with an expected increase in Summer 2027. Travel may be required for meetings, conferences, and rollout events.

FWI is expanding rapidly and has been recognized as a 2024, 2025 and 2026 Top Workplace, offering excellent growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities:

**Strategic Communications and Media Strategy**

* Work with AWC senior staff to develop and execute the Commission's national security–focused media messaging strategy, including social media engagement.
* Advise senior staff on the Government's use of social media platforms, including which platforms are restricted and how each platform retains and preserves data.
* Recommend and facilitate engagement with media outlets to promote the final report and other releases and events before and after the report's release.
* Provide expert counsel on brand development, public positioning, visibility, reputation risk management, and media engagement.
* Research specific articles, reporters, and outlets as needed.

**Digital Content and Web Development**

* Lead the design and development of an enhanced AWC website and online presence so users can easily access and navigate the lengthy final report and collateral materials. This work draws on WordPress, UX/UI and web design, and interactive approaches to large-scale data visualization.
* Post on, edit, and otherwise manage AWC social media accounts at the direction of senior staff.
* Track social media analytics and advise on growing followers and improving visibility.

**Content Development and Production**

* Prepare, coordinate, and execute digital newsletter and social media campaigns for public awareness, data collection (as approved by senior staff), and event notifications.
* Oversee the production of video, digital, and graphic materials such as infographics.
* Prepare media materials, including press kits, background materials, press releases, talking points, and presentations.
* Advise on and provide technical support for the final report publication, including writing, editing, design, and formatting.

**Public Event Coordination and Support**

* Plan, execute, and facilitate hearings, press conferences, interviews, podcasts, conferences, forums, roundtables, media availabilities, and other public events.
* Respond to media inquiries and schedule interviews.
* Help track compliance with the AWC's Media and Publication guidelines.
* Provide media training for Commissioners and Commission staff.

**Media Monitoring and Analysis**

* Alert AWC staff to breaking news relevant to the Commission's work and prepare response advice as needed.
* Provide regular media updates and summaries of relevant news, trends, and articles, as directed by senior staff.
* Measure and analyze coverage of the AWC across traditional, social, and other media, using parameters set by the overall communications strategy.

**Data Visualization Support**

* Oversee the creation of accurate, innovative charts, graphs, dashboards, timelines, maps, and other visuals for print and digital use, based on AWC data and guidance.
* Manage an intensive editing process with AWC, incorporating and reconciling frequent changes and independently validating visualization integrity.
* Coordinate with the AWC's designated print report publisher to integrate finalized visualizations.

Qualifications:

Required:

* Bachelor's degree
* Proficiency with WordPress platforms and interactive or illustrative approaches to large-scale data visualization.
* At least 6 years' demonstrated ability in media relations, content production (written, video, digital, graphic), event management, media training, and media analysis.

Desired:

* Experience engaging the U.S. military, national security agencies, Congress, veterans communities, and national and international media.
* Knowledge of and connections within the Afghanistan War, military affairs, veterans affairs, and foreign policy communities. The Director should be able to use these to launch the AWC's media presence quickly and effectively.
* In-depth understanding of national security and foreign policy audiences, and command of current communications technologies and best practices.

**FWI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets.**

At FWI, we place the highest importance on creating an exceptional employee experience. You'll have opportunities to achieve your career aspirations through internal promotions, professional development, and other recognition and rewards programs. Join our team and take advantage of the many benefits we offer, including:

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Streamside Parks is a premier property management company specializing in the operation and enhancement of RV Park Resorts & Campgrounds across the Southeast. Streamside oversees a growing portfolio of 40+ parks, delivering consistent, high-quality experiences for residents and campers alike. With a focus on operational excellence, streamlined processes, and guest satisfaction, Streamside Parks ensures each property thrives under the unified Streamside brand while maintaining a strong financial performance and a commitment to continuous improvement.  
  
**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The Project Coordinator supports ownership across every active Streamside Parks project by keeping budgets, vendor commitments, permits, and project documentation organized, current, and easy to act on. This is a coordination and tracking role, not a design or engineering role: the Project Coordinator keeps information flowing and deadlines visible so ownership and outside professionals (engineers, surveyors, electricians, architects) can make timely decisions, rather than making design, engineering, or regulatory determinations independently.  
  
**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Budget and Cost Tracking**

* Maintain detailed project budget workbooks across multiple properties (division level tabs plus a master summary), keeping line items current as quotes, change orders, and actual costs come in.

  

* Compare vendor and contractor quotes against budgeted line items and flag variances to ownership.

  

* Track payment schedules and deposit or draw requirements against contracts and vendor terms.

  

* Coordinate with the accounting team on capital projects, making sure invoices, draws, and capital expenditures are coded, recorded, and reconciled against each project's budget.

  
**Vendor and Contractor Coordination**  

* Solicit, log, and compare quotes from vendors and contractors (signage, site work, utilities, construction trades, and similar scopes).

  

* Track vendor deliverables and installation schedules, and coordinate scheduling between vendors, on site staff, and ownership.

  

* Support decisions about which scopes of work are handled by outside contractors versus in house or property staff, by organizing the cost and scheduling information ownership needs to decide.

  

* Prepare contractor pay applications for ownership's approval, checking billed amounts against contract terms and percentage of work complete.

  

* Collect lien waivers from contractors and subcontractors with each payment cycle and keep them on file.

  

* Track construction schedules for contractors on specific jobs, monitoring progress against milestones and flagging delays to ownership.

  
**Acquisition Due Diligence Support**  

* Assemble and organize due diligence materials for prospective acquisitions: title work, surveys (ALTA and boundary), flood zone and FEMA determinations, utility and electrical system condition, and environmental reports.

  

* Track open due diligence items and deadlines through closing, and flag gaps that need a licensed surveyor, engineer, or attorney.

  
**Permitting and Regulatory Tracking**  

* Track permit applications and approval status across jurisdictions and property types (site development, electrical, water and wastewater, building).

  

* Maintain a working awareness of the codes and regulations that commonly apply to RV resort development, and route code specific questions to the appropriate licensed professional rather than answering them directly.

  
**Site Plans and Project Documentation**  

* Maintain current versions of civil site plans, sign packages, and other project drawings, and track what changed between revisions.

  

* Reconcile changes in project scope (for example, a shift in unit count or unit type) against the current site plan and flag discrepancies to ownership and the design consultant.

  

* Maintain accurate site and unit counts (RV sites, cabins, cottages, buildings) drawn from current drawings and spreadsheets, and keep that inventory consistent across budget, narrative, and marketing documents.

  

* Prepare project narratives and status summaries that bring together survey, site plan, budget, and vendor information for ownership review.

  
**Cross Property Scheduling and Reporting**  

* Track milestones across all active projects, from due diligence through construction or capital improvement completion.

  

* Surface scheduling conflicts, resourcing needs, and upcoming deadlines to ownership before they become urgent.

  

* Prepare periodic status updates summarizing progress, open items, and near-term priorities across the portfolio.

  

* Keep every active project current in Wrike, the company's project management software, including tasks, owners, due dates, and status, so ownership has a reliable single place to check progress.

  
**Qualifications**  
Required  

* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing several concurrent projects and vendors at once.

  

* Strong spreadsheet skills, including multi tab workbooks, formulas, and budget tracking in Excel or a comparable tool.

  

* Clear written communication, including the ability to summarize project status for ownership concisely.

  

* Ability to read and track changes across site plans, drawings, and vendor quotes, without needing to produce or approve them independently.

  

* Willingness to travel to project sites as needed, and a valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

  
**Preferred**  

* Experience with Wrike or a comparable project management platform (Asana, Monday.com, or similar).

  

* Experience in real estate development, construction project coordination, or hospitality and outdoor hospitality operations (RV resorts, campgrounds, or similar).

  

* Familiarity with due diligence documents common to real estate acquisitions (surveys, title work, flood zone determinations).

  

* Working familiarity with permitting processes and basic regulatory concepts relevant to site development (site permitting, electrical, water and wastewater), understanding that licensed professionals remain responsible for code compliance determinations.

  
**Work Environment and Travel**  
This role works closely and directly with ownership in a small, fast moving team, supporting projects at different stages, from early due diligence to active construction to post opening operations.  
  
Reporting and Employment Details  
Reports to: Director Of CAPEX & Facilities  
  
**Location:** Based in Middle Tennessee (preferred), with occasional regional travel to project sites.  
  
**Employment type:** Full time  
  
**Classification:** Salaried, exempt from overtime.  
  
  
This job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and responsibilities. Streamside Parks reserves the right to modify responsibilities as business needs evolve.

title: Growth Marketer, SEO and Lifecycle
description:
**Growth Marketer, SEO and Lifecycle**
--------------------------------------

**Location:** Dallas, Austin, or Remote (US) with Central/Eastern overlap  
**Compensation:** 70,000-85,000 base, plus equity  
**Department:** Growth  
**Reports to:** Director of Growth

### **About Rare Candy**

We’re a leading marketplace dedicated to trading card games—Pokémon, MTG, Lorcana, and more—used by millions of collectors to buy, sell, and showcase their collections. Our operations team powers the logistics that ensure trading cards and collectibles move quickly and safely between sellers and collectors. We grew almost 30x last year, and we aren't slowing down.

### **The Role**

We're hiring a Growth Marketer to take our programmatic SEO program to the next level and help refine our lifecycle marketing.

Search already works for us. Our blog drives over a million search impressions a week and converts well. But a blog only scales as fast as people can write. We have data on every card, set, product, and price, and we want pages for all of it. Your job is to build the system that gets there. You'll find the page types collectors are searching for, build them with automation and AI, and keep quality high across thousands of pages.

You'll also work alongside our lifecycle team on email, push, and experiments that get new collectors active and keep them coming back. Over time, you'll grow into owning either activation or retention.

### **What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 days:** You know what's working in our blog and why: which topics, formats, and intent drive impressions and signups. You've mapped where programmatic pages can extend that, and which page types to build first. You've learned our lifecycle setup and shipped your first campaigns with the team.

**By day 90:**

* Your programmatic roadmap is approved and in motion.
* The first programmatic page types are live, starting with current Pokémon sets.
* A repeatable build and quality-control workflow is running.
* Reporting connects search impressions to signups and revenue across both the blog and programmatic pages.
* You're running lifecycle campaigns alongside the team, and you've launched at least one measurable activation or retention experiment.

**By the end of year one:**

* Programmatic pages cover Pokémon and at least one more game.
* Programmatic pages are a meaningful share of our organic signups, alongside the blog.
* You're ready to own activation or retention.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own the programmatic SEO roadmap and build operation.
* Use what's working in our blog to find page types, keyword clusters, and internal-linking opportunities worth scaling.
* Prioritize current Pokémon sets first, then MTG, Lorcana, and Riftbound as capacity allows.
* Build programmatic pages using our card and product data, automation tools, and AI.
* Work with engineering on structured data, indexing, and technical SEO when it needs their hands.
* Build Instapack pages ahead of launches and coordinate timing with the team.
* Set quality checks for accuracy, duplication, and brand voice, and hold every batch to them.
* Track rankings, impressions, organic traffic, activation, and revenue.
* Partner with our lifecycle team on email, push, segmentation, activation, and retention campaigns.
* Help test whether offers like bonus candy actually improve retention.
* Run a weekly SEO production and performance review.

### **A Day in Your Life at Rare Candy**

You start the morning in Search Console. Pages for last month's Pokémon set are picking up impressions, but a few are cannibalizing our blog posts, so you adjust the internal links and the template.

Midday, you're tweaking the automation that pulls fresh price data into set pages, so they update without anyone touching them.

In the afternoon, you QA a batch of 200 new pages against your checklist and fix the dozen that miss.

You end the day with the lifecycle team, reviewing results from a push test on new users who scanned their first card but haven't bought yet.

### **You Might Be a Fit If**

* You have 2 to 4 years in SEO, organic growth, lifecycle marketing, or a related growth role.
* You've done hands-on SEO on a large or data-heavy site. Programmatic SEO experience is a big plus.
* You're comfortable building with automation and AI tools, and you've used them to produce at a scale one person couldn't do by hand.
* You know Google Search Console, analytics tools, and keyword research tools well.
* You're comfortable working with large datasets and templates.
* You've worked on email, push, segmentation, or retention campaigns, even if it wasn't your main job.
* You know where AI gets things wrong, and you build checks to catch it.
* You're a strong project manager. You keep writers and timelines moving, and people know where things stand without having to ask.
* You check your own work before anyone else sees it, and you bring decisions rather than drafts.
* You're into Pokémon, TCGs, collectibles, or another enthusiast community.

### **Bonus Points**

* Experience at a marketplace or catalog-heavy site where every item, set, or listing gets a page.
* Experience with Customer.io, Iterable, or a similar lifecycle tool.

### **Why Join Us Now**

* Take a search channel that already works and build the programmatic layer that scales it.
* Work directly with our Director of Growth and engineering team.
* A clear path to owning a piece of lifecycle as you grow.
* A salary range of 70,000-85,000, plus equity.
* Full benefits: health, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), and a wellness stipend.
* A monthly dogfooding budget to spend on cards, because we hire people who love this hobby.

### **Our Hiring Process**

* 30-min intro chat with Taylor (Director of Growth).
* Working session (45 minutes): walk us through a site you think does programmatic SEO well and how you'd tell if it's working.
* Paid exercise (about 3 hours, $200): we'll send you a slice of our card and set data. Show us one page type you'd build, the keyword logic behind it, how you'd build it with automation and AI, and how you'd QA 1,000 of those pages before they go live.
* Panel with our Growth team and engineering.
* Reference calls and an offer within 1 week of the final interview.

### **How to Apply**

Apply through our Ashby posting and answer these:

* Tell us about an SEO project you worked on. What did you own, what did you build, and what happened to traffic?
* Tell us about a workflow you automated. What tools did you use, and what did it let you do that you couldn't before?
* What's something collectors search for that nobody answers well yet?

Rare Candy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate individuality, from Pikachu collectors to Planeswalker pros, and are committed to building an inclusive team.

title: Pharmacist - Clinical Advisor
description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor is a client facing role that manages the clinical relationship by influencing multiple key decision makers at a health plan. These include the health plan’s pharmacy support team, pharmacists, medical directors, CMO as well as other senior health plan leaders.

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor should be able to manage at least 2 and up to 4 market segments for any particular client (Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange, or Commercial).

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor is responsible for proactively managing the clinical relationship alongside the business lead (SAE/SAD) to understand and drive each of their client’s priorities, financial targets, clinical goals and other commitments to their leadership.

  

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor will analyze and evaluate the client’s data and competitive marketplace conditions and forces to develop and execute a comprehensive business plan that supports the client’s short- and long-term profitability and growth strategies. Key components being eliminating waste, reducing inefficiency and maximizing impact to manage chronic disease. This includes:

  

* Collaborating with clients on analysis of their key marketplace competitors and those products and services.
* Consulting with and recommending standard and custom formulary options and utilization management edits.
* Collaborating with internal partners to develop or modify custom programs or formularies that meet the unique needs of health plan clients.
* Collaborating with CVSH trade partners on formulary strategies to maximize rebate value and drives lowest net cost.
* Consulting with and recommending utilization management programs or other clinical programs to a client.
* Consulting with and recommending specialty drug strategy options.
* Consulting with ANCS, to utilize clinical and financial reports to evaluate current benefit design and provide recommendations to clients on any opportunities.
* Consulting and Influence clients on current drugs trends, drug pipeline, as well as proactive monitoring of FWA trends.
* Consulting and influencing clients on a regular basis, developing a trusted consultative partnership that drives client loyalty and fulfills both clients commitments and CVSH goals.
* Conducting Provider and Member outreach as needed for client communications.

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor will consult with and advise the Clinical Benefits Pharmacist, and or other members of the Benefits and Operations teams so that those teams can timely and accurately implement a client’s requirements.

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor will collaborate with CVSH internal partners to ensure compliance to any federal, state or local regulatory requirements that impact formulary, UM and or clinical programs and consult with any clients on the impact that such requirements might have on their plan.

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor is accountable for ensuring that CVSH meets or exceeds any health plan client value targets each year and is responsible for proactively collaborating with business leads to identify client value and then provide consultative advice and follow up with the client on such recommendations. Consultative advice may include recommendations for program pilots, modification to existing CVSH programs to support the unique needs of the health plan segment and marketplace and/or how CVSH as an enterprise can support health plans through our open source model.

The Health Plan Clinical Advisor is responsible for ensuring they meet or exceed their personal and departmental client satisfaction scores target each year.

This position can be located in a CVSH Corporate Hub or can work remotely/work from home within the United States. Clinical Advisors must have the ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of managed care Pharmacist experience and/or 1 year of Managed Care Residency program.
* Active pharmacist license that is in good standing.
* Demonstrated experience in a client-facing role within the managed care environment
* Demonstrated understanding of and experience with utilization management trends and programs within the managed care environment
* Highly organized, detail oriented, proficient analytical ability with effective listening & presentation skills are required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of experience supporting Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) clients or within a health plan.
* Experience in all market segments (Medicare, Medicaid, Exchange and Commercial)
* Expertise in Utilization Management, Formulary Management and Clinical Products
* Proven leadership skills.
* Strong business acumen.
* Commitment to client service and relationship building.
* Experience implementing template and/or customized clinical programs.
* Knowledge of PBM adjudication engine and other systems leveraged in support of clients.
* AMCP Fundamentals of Managed Care Pharmacy Certificate or similar professional advancement.

**Education**  
BS in Pharmacy or PharmD

Active, unrestricted pharmacist licensure in at least 1 state

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$110,925.00 - $249,600.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design

We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
